title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer – Real Time Engineering
jobDescription: Senior Site Reliability Engineer – Real Time Engineering We are hiring Site Reliability Engineers (SREs) to expand our team supporting LSEG’s Real Time application space. This space provides thousands of clients with access to trading and market data globally. Our team mitigates operational risk, enables fast product innovation, and continuously improves customer experience. As an SRE, you will take ownership of operational support, contribute to cloud migration initiatives, and help automate operational tasks. You will build and evolve observability capabilities, apply data-driven and AI-assisted insights, and develop strong domain expertise. You will work as part of a diverse, globally distributed team in a fast-paced environment that processes real-time data. Key Responsibilities Lead incident recovery efforts by analyzing complex situations, forming hypotheses, and coordinating effective recovery actions. Apply structured problem-solving and critical thinking to identify root causes across distributed systems. Produce clear, high-quality incident reports and participate in post-incident reviews to drive reliability improvements. Maintain production stability by assessing deployment risks and using operational data to identify reliability concerns. Automate operational processes and use AI-assisted tools to enhance observability, alerting, and troubleshooting. Develop strong understanding of application dataflows, dependencies, and networking topologies. Collaborate with development teams on backlog prioritization, project intake, operational acceptance testing, and Game Day activities. Technical & Professional Qualifications Experience with UNIX/Linux administration, scripting, and automation. Hands-on experience supporting cloud-native applications, preferably on Azure; AWS experience is an advantage. Understanding networking fundamentals such as TCP/IP, UDP traffic, HTTP, and DNS. Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and container-based platforms. Ability to troubleshoot distributed systems using logical reasoning and data-driven analysis. Experience with observability tools; DataDog and BigPanda experience is highly desirable. Familiarity with Git or similar version control systems. Bachelor's degree in computer science or related field, or equivalent practical experience. Relevant industry experience; customer-facing operational support experience is a plus. Critical Thinking & AI-Enabled Engineering We value engineers who think critically, challenge assumptions, and make sound decisions in complex and high-pressure situations. Experience using data-driven insights and AI-assisted tools to improve observability, automate operations, or accelerate incident diagnosis is highly valued. You do not need to be an AI specialist—curiosity, learning mindset, and practical application matter most. LSEG is a leading global financial markets infrastructure and data provider. title: Senior Manager - Site Program Management
jobDescription: Job Description Job Title Senior Manager – Site Management Team (India) Reporting Line Reports to: India Country Head Career Level Senior Manager / Director (individual contributor with enterprise influence) Experience 12–15 years of experience in programme management, operations, governance, or site / enterprise enablement roles within large, matrixed organisations. Role Purpose The Senior Manager – Site Management Team is accountable for programme management and operational oversight of site-level priorities across LSEG India. The role ensures effective execution of the Site Target Operating Model (TOM), robust governance, disciplined delivery, and strong connectivity between site councils, leadership forums, and global/regional stakeholders. The role operates as a trusted partner to the India Country Head, enabling leadership focus through structured execution, risk awareness, high-quality stakeholder engagement, and by supporting the delivery of change, innovation and modern ways of working across the site. Key Accountabilities · Own end-to-end programme management for site-level initiatives aligned to the Site TOM. · Manage plans, dependencies, milestones, risks and resourcing across concurrent priorities. · Track delivery outcomes and provide clear, decision-oriented updates to Site Leadership and the Business Leadership Council (BLC). · Establish and maintain site governance artefacts including dashboards, MI, and documentation. · Support structured governance forums, reviews and action tracking. · Act as the primary coordination point between site councils, leadership teams and global/regional stakeholders. · Embed risk awareness into site initiatives, supporting mitigation and resilience activities. · Oversee planning, allocation and utilisation of site-level budgets with appropriate financial governance. · Identify opportunities to simplify processes, improve effectiveness and embed best practices. · Support and lead delivery of change initiatives, fostering innovation and enabling modern ways of working across the site. · Enable smooth delivery of site-level programmes, leadership meetings and key events. · Connect and collaborate with global site management forums for consistent ways of working and shared outcomes Skills & Capability Requirements · Strong stakeholder management and influencing capability at senior leadership level. · Excellent written and verbal communication skills. · Demonstrated programme management and execution discipline. · Strong understanding of governance, risk and control frameworks. · Financial and commercial acumen, including budget oversight. · Ability to operate effectively in a global, matrixed organisation. Leadership & LSEG Behaviours · Acts with integrity, accountability and sound judgement. · Demonstrates ownership, resilience and delivery focus. · Applies a risk-aware, control-conscious mindset. · Collaborates effectively and influences without authority. · Focuses on outcomes, simplification and continuous improvement. title: Development Team Lead(.NET)
jobDescription: LSEG (London Stock Exchange Group) is more than a diversified global financial markets infrastructure and data business. We are dedicated, open-access partners with a dedication to excellence in delivering the services our customers expect from us. With extensive experience, deep knowledge and worldwide presence across financial markets, we enable businesses and economies around the world to fund innovation, manage risk and create jobs. It’s how we’ve contributed to supporting the financial stability and growth of communities and economies globally for more than 300 years. Through a comprehensive suite of trusted financial market infrastructure services – and our open-access model – we provide the flexibility, stability and trust that enable our customers to pursue their ambitions with confidence and clarity. LSEG is headquartered in the United Kingdom, with significant operations in 65 countries across EMEA, North America, Latin America and Asia Pacific. We employ 25,000 people globally, more than half located in Asia Pacific. LSEG’s ticker symbol is LSEG. OUR PEOPLE: People are at the heart of what we do and drive the success of our business. Our values of Integrity, Partnership, Excellence and Change shape how we think, how we do things and how we help our people fulfil their potential. We embrace diversity and actively seek to attract individuals with unique backgrounds and perspectives. We break down barriers and encourage teamwork, enabling innovation and rapid development of solutions that make a difference. Our workplace generates an enriching and rewarding experience for our people and customers alike. Our vision is to build an inclusive culture in which everyone feels encouraged to fulfil their potential. We know that real personal growth cannot be achieved by simply climbing a career ladder – which is why we encourage and enable a wealth of avenues and interesting opportunities for everyone to broaden and deepen their skills and expertise. As a global organisation spanning 65 countries and one rooted in a culture of growth, opportunity, diversity and innovation, LSEG is a place where everyone can grow, develop and fulfil your potential with meaningful careers. Position Overview The Development Team Lead (.NET) is responsible for providing hands‑on technical leadership, mentoring, and delivery oversight for a team building enterprise applications on the Microsoft .NET platform. This role blends deep .NET expertise with people leadership, Agile delivery, and cross‑functional collaboration. The Team Lead works closely with Product, QA, DevOps, Architecture, and Delivery to ensure consistent, predictable, and high‑quality delivery. Key Responsibilities Technical Leadership Lead the design and development of applications using C#, VB.NET, ASP.NET Core, ASP.NET MVC, Web API, LINQ, and related .NET technologies. Guide modernization of legacy VB.NET applications into C# or .NET Core where appropriate. Perform and enforce high‑quality code reviews, ensuring adherence to coding standards, clean architecture, and SOLID principles. Break down complex technical requirements into well‑scoped stories and tasks. Work with Architects to align on technical patterns, integration approaches, and long‑term platform direction. People Leadership & Coaching Provide day‑to‑day support, mentorship, and coaching to developers across varying experience levels. Foster a positive, inclusive culture centered on learning, ownership, and accountability. Conduct regular 1:1s and support career development, skills progression, and performance management. Agile Delivery & Planning Lead sprint planning, backlog readiness, estimation, and throughput optimization. Facilitate daily stand‑ups, reviews, and retrospectives; remove team impediments rapidly. Coordinate dependencies with QA, DevOps, and other teams; ensure release readiness and change control. Partner with the Delivery Manager (or act in that capacity where needed) to maintain predictable sprint throughput and reliable release timelines. Quality & Reliability Ensure strong testing practices: unit testing (xUnit/NUnit/MSTest), integration testing, API testing, and automation support and high code coverage targets. Collaborate with QA to embed quality in the workflow; drive shift‑left testing practices. Validate that applications meet non‑functional requirements such as performance, resilience, and security. Collaborate with DevOps to improve CI/CD pipelines, environment stability, and release automation. System & Application Ownership Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues across environments (DEV/QA/UAT/PROD). Lead root cause analysis for production incidents and identify long‑term fixes. Monitor application health using Application Insights, logging frameworks, and dashboards. Cross‑Functional Collaboration Partner with Product Owners to refine user stories, clarify requirements, and provide estimates. Work closely with DevOps for CI/CD enhancements and infrastructure needs (Azure preferred). Collaborate with QA Lead, Architecture, and Security teams to ensure compliance with standards. Qualifications Required 6+ years of professional software development experience with .NET Framework and .NET Core. 2+ years in a people leader role. Strong expertise in C#, with working knowledge of VB.NET (maintenance, migration, or modernization). Experience building REST APIs, microservices, or modular applications using ASP.NET Core/Web API. Proficiency with Git, CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions), unit testing frameworks, and design patterns. Experience working in Agile environments (Scrum/Kanban) with strong facilitation skills. Demonstrated ability to lead teams, influence architecture, and deliver complex initiatives. Excellent communication, facilitation, and problem‑solving skills. Preferred Experience in a multi‑team environment with shared services (QA, DevOps, Architecture). Familiarity with observability (logs, metrics, tracing) and performance tuning. Exposure to relational and NoSQL data stores, messaging, and event‑driven patterns. Exposure to DevOps concepts such as IaC (Bicep, ARM, Terraform). Certifications such as PSM I/II, CSM, PMI‑ACP, or Azure Developer/Architect certifications. title: Senior Lead DevOps Engineer
jobDescription: LSEG (London Stock Exchange Group) is a leading global financial markets infrastructure and data provider. LSEG makes financial data accessible to its customers. When source financial data is found in a narrative, unstructured text format, it is required to extract and convert the relevant information found in it in a structured, accessible format. title: Business Analyst
jobDescription: The Commodities team is responsible for delivering high quality pricing and fundamentals data, including physical assets, production and consumption metrics, trading flows, and market statistics that power both external customer products and internal research and forecasting teams. This role sits at the intersection of content, technology, analytics, and quality assurance. You will translate business and analytical needs into robust functional specifications, lead complex content initiatives, and ensure datasets meet the highest standards of accuracy, completeness, and usability across LSEG’s flagship platforms. What This Role Delivers Scalable, well defined commodities datasets High quality, analytics ready content supporting client insights Strong alignment between Content, Research, Technology, and Product teams Measurable improvements in data quality, testing coverage, and delivery efficiency Key Responsibilities Business Analysis & Content Onboarding Review and analyse business requirements for new projects and content initiatives. Research source data and draft functional and technical specifications for onboarding new commodities datasets and enhancing existing content. Translate customer needs into clear, testable, and scalable requirements, challenging existing processes where needed. Build deep domain expertise through ongoing engagement with Research, Forecast, Propositions, and external data providers. Project Leadership & Delivery Lead large‑scale content onboarding, enhancement, and migration initiatives from definition through delivery. Coordinate across Content, Technology, QA, and Business Delivery teams to ensure timely and accurate execution. Support migration and modernization programs by defining specifications for new platforms, tools, and infrastructure. Contribute to implementation planning, UAT coordination, post‑release validation, and issue resolution. Data Quality, Analytics & Testing Track and resolve complex data quality and data integration issues, analysing large datasets to identify root causes. Conduct data and analytics acceptance testing, including discrepancy analysis and common factor validation. Ensure robust test coverage across functional and non‑functional requirements, improving confidence in product releases. Identify patterns in defects or customer feedback and drive preventative improvements. Automation, Efficiency & Continuous Improvement Identify opportunities to increase automation efficiency and reduce test execution time. Develop efficient ways of working across content and testing processes. Contribute to building quality metrics, dashboards, and measurement frameworks that support data driven decisions. Stay ahead with evolving content tools, workflows, and technologies, applying learning directly to delivery. Engagement & Collaboration Act as a trusted partner to Research teams, Technology, Propositions, Product, and Content Management. Communicate effectively with interested parties at all levels, presenting findings, risks, and recommendations clearly. Operate independently while remaining a strong, collaborative team contributor. Mentor colleagues and share standard methodologies across content and quality disciplines where appropriate. Required Skills & Experience Core Capabilities Solid experience as a Business Analyst working in complex environments. Demonstrable ability to gather, document, and translate requirements into functional specifications. Exceptional analytical and problem solving skills, with a high level of accuracy and attention to detail. Ability to manage complexity, think logically, and challenge assumptions constructively. Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills with confidence engaging senior audiences. Background in content testing and release management. Demonstrated ability to improve automation, tooling, or testing frameworks. Solid understanding of data management concepts, including data lineage, data governance frameworks, DBoR restructuring and migration initiatives, and system to system data connectivity. Technical & Data Skills Advanced SQL skills, including complex queries and logical data validation checks. Experience working with large datasets without losing analytical clarity. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Power BI, and working knowledge of Python. Familiarity with LSEG products such as Workspace, Eikon, Data Scope Suite (DSS). Desirable Skills Fair understanding of Commodities data Proactive approach with a willingness to challenge the status quo and drive improvement. Provide local leadership for all Shared Services team members in Bengaluru, acting as site lead and ensuring Shared Services is integrated into and represented in all local site leadership forums. Ensures the organisation is properly resourced with a focus on high quality engineering talent, and creating a positive environment and team dynamic Plans appropriately for growth, and all the delivery teams have been trained in appropriate methodologies and understand their role in the organisation. Champions and delivers an agile delivery methodology and a continuous improvement framework to drive efficiency and enable business agility. Innovates in partnership with product management function and senior technology roles to deliver revenue growth whilst maintaining the highest standards of resilience. Drives cost reduction of delivery and maintenance through technology and process innovation. Implements a governance framework for technology delivery to ensure appropriate reporting and remedial actions are being undertaken to keep delivery backlogs on track and within budget. Maintains relationships with key suppliers, setting performance standards and leading the resolution of important priority service issues. Develops high performing and diverse teams, with established talent pipelines and clear succession plans. Directs and leads others, coordinating activities and providing encouragement and inspiration to help others succeed. Engages in discussion to reach an agreement and create outcomes, affecting the action, behaviours, or opinions of others. title: Senior Lead Software Engineer - Frontend Developer
jobDescription: ROLE PROFILE: We are seeking a Senior Lead Frontend Developer to join our Customers Identity & Access Management team at LSEG. You will play a pivotal role in maintaining and evolving our JavaScript SDK, a critical interface that enables secure authentication and seamless integration of our Authentication into client applications across to our customers. Design intuitive, developer-friendly APIs that abstract complex authentication flows (OAuth2, OpenID Connect). Ensure the SDK is secure, performant, and easy to integrate across a wide range of frontend applications. Collaborate with backend engineers to align SDK functionality with evolving identity protocols and token flows. Build automated tests and CI pipelines to ensure quality, reliability, and backward compatibility. Write clear documentation and sample apps to support internal and external developers. Strong understanding of OAuth2, OpenID Connect, and secure authentication flows. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and versioning strategies for SDKs. Experience with frontend performance optimization, cross-browser compatibility, and accessibility standards. Passion for clean code, automation, and continuous improvement. jobDescription: About us: LSEG (London Stock Exchange Group) is more than a diversified global financial markets infrastructure and data business. Our vision is to build an inclusive culture in which everyone feels encouraged to fulfil their potential. As a global organization spanning 70 countries and one rooted in a culture of growth, opportunity, diversity and innovation, LSEG is a place where everyone can grow, develop and fulfil your potential with meaningful careers. About this role This role is instrumental in supporting the Sales Assurance head and senior leadership team in driving the integrity, efficiency, and effectiveness of the organization’s end-to-end sales process. The incumbent will be responsible for ensuring accurate and compliant sales recording and reporting. This includes working closely with cross-functional teams such as SAM Finance, Order Management Systems, Billing, Reporting & Analytics, FP&A, and Controllership to ensure seamless process integration and data consistency Responsibilities & Key Accountabilities: Monitor and evaluate sales transactions and processes to ensure compliance with internal policies Collaborate with Sales & Accounts Management, Controllership, Reporting & Analytics, FP&A, OMS and Billing teams to implement best practices and improve sales governance Identify process gaps and recommend corrective actions / improvements to enhance efficiency and reduce risk Ability to work with disparate data sets / systems and create data package(s) which conveys intelligent information to aid in decision making Drive continuous improvement initiatives to improve sales processes by implementing the best practices and innovative solutions Identifies opportunities to mitigate risks and strive for robust control environment. Senior Stakeholder management skills to effectively communicate with ability to have a good connect with relevant business partners and be a fine team contributor. Ready to learn / adapt to new financial reporting systems. Assist in the development and refinement of sales assurance frameworks, SOPs, and quality assurance Analyze sales queries during month close to understand root cause and fix as necessary to reduce volume of sales queries and resolve them in timely manner Requirements: Master’s degree in business administration, finance or a related field (MBA preferred) 6-8 years of experience in sales assurance, revenue assurance or compliance, preferably in a sales-driven environment in BFSI sector. Experience of working with systems: SAP, Oracle, Pyramid, Hyperion, Salesforce, CRM an added advantage Strong interpersonal skills: both verbal and written, with the ability to clearly and concisely interact with personnel at all management levels Excellent knowledge of MS Excel, MS Word and PowerPoint; familiarity with new generation analytical tools (preferably Power BI) would be highly desirable Strong analytical skills: able to clearly link financial results to operational performance drivers, generate alternatives and drive positive change. Clear thinking/problem solving; successfully led projects/operational improvements within operations/finance function. Flexibility to work per UK hours. title: Site Reliability Engineer
jobDescription: ROLE SUMMARY: We are hiring a Site Reliability Engineer to help us run and improve LSEG's internal observability platform - and we want you to be part of building something that matters! Our platform brings telemetry, dashboards, alerts, service health, and operational insight into one common experience. We use it to help engineering and service teams detect issues earlier, reduce incident impact, and improve operational reliability. The focus of this role is the platform itself - its reliability, supportability, and usability - and the standards and self-service patterns that help teams adopt it consistently. This is not a general application monitoring role; ownership of dashboards, alerts, or telemetry for every application team is not what we are looking for here. WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING: Platform operations and reliability: - Monitor platform health, investigate and diagnose issues, and support service recovery across production and non-production environments. - Contribute to service readiness through dashboards, SLOs, SLIs, runbooks, resilience checks, and performance validation. - Use metrics, logs, traces, and service health data to understand issues and guide practical decisions. Incident response and continuous improvement: - Support incident response, triage, problem management, and root cause analysis. - Drive follow-up actions that reduce repeat issues and improve operational consistency. - Improve automation and GitOps-based workflows to reduce manual work across the team. Enablement and documentation: - Maintain documentation, onboarding guides, and self-service tooling so teams can operate with less reliance on direct support. - Provide direct enablement on telemetry standards, alerting guidance, SLO practices, and platform workflows. WHAT YOU'LL BRING: Essential skills and experience: - Experience supporting production platforms or services in an SRE, platform engineering, infrastructure, DevOps, or operations engineering role. - Experience using observability data such as metrics, logs, traces, alerts, dashboards, or service health views to investigate issues. - Understanding of incident response, problem management, service readiness, or operational support processes. - Experience using automation or infrastructure-as-code practices to support repeatable delivery and operations. - Solid understanding of cloud, container, Linux, networking, or distributed system environments. - Ability to communicate technical information clearly to engineering, operations, and service stakeholders. - Experience writing or maintaining operational documentation such as runbooks, support guides, or onboarding material. - A practical approach to improving reliability, reducing manual work, and helping teams use shared platforms optimally. Desirable skills and experience: - Experience with observability, monitoring, telemetry, or data pipeline technologies such as OpenTelemetry, Grafana, ClickHouse, Cribl, Datadog, BigPanda, Redis, Flink, or similar tools. - Experience with GitOps workflows and tools such as Git, CI/CD pipelines, pull requests, environment promotion, or configuration-as-code. - Experience building or supporting internal platforms used by multiple engineering teams. - Experience defining or using SLOs, SLIs, error budgets, alert quality measures, or service health models. - Experience supporting telemetry pipelines, data routing, data filtering, retention, or cost management. - Experience working in a regulated, financial services, or large enterprise technology environment. - Experience helping engineering teams adopt shared standards, templates, or self-service platform capabilities. WHAT YOU'LL GET IN RETURN: This is a phenomenal opportunity to work on a platform that directly improves how teams across LSEG understand and operate their systems! title: Engineer, Site Reliability Engineering
jobDescription: Our Team We are evolving our Reliability Engineering team to move beyond support and operations. As a Senior Engineer in Site Reliability, you will be part of a diverse and inclusive organization that has full ownership of the availability, performance, and scalability of one of the most critical shared services at LSEG. We are looking for people with a passion for learning and a continuous improvement mindset to join our Electronic Trading (ET) team. As a Site Reliability Engineer, you will be responsible for the design, reliability, and operational excellence of our high- performance FX trading platform technology used by major financial institutions around the world. This role plays a key part in ensuring our trading systems remain robust, secure, scalable, and highly available. You will work across complex, mission critical environments and drive architectural enhancements that support the future of our platform. The ET platform is a highly configurable, component-based FX dealing system delivered as isolated client instances. It supports direct electronic trading via web interfaces, connectivity adaptors, and APIs. The platform integrates seamlessly with market rate providers, credit engines, and backend services to enable full straight through processing. What You Will Do Own and maintain Service Level Objectives (SLOs) for the systems you support. Continuously measure and improve availability, and overall system health. Develop automation to scale systems sustainably and prevent or mitigate service issues. Partner with development teams to enhance reliability, observability, and release velocity. Participate in on-call rotations, incident response, post incident reviews, and root cause analysis. Promote strong engineering practices to help build, deploy, and operate high performance services. Act as a key enabler for Cloud migration, working with operations and engineering teams from project inception through to operational readiness. Conduct architectural reviews, support operational acceptance testing, and configure Datadog dashboards and metrics. You will need to have experience of DevOps or operating highly available distributed systems, strong scripting and automation skills (Bash,Python,etc). Understanding of Linux and cloud environments. Knowledge of working with financial trading systems an advantage. Minimum qualifications A bachelor's degree in computer science, a related technical field involving software/systems engineering, or equivalent practical experience. Experience with programming languages such as: Java, C#, Python. Experience with relational databases and SQL Experience with Infrastructure as Code. Experience in Observability practices with logging, metrics, tracing, and alerting. Hands on Experience with one of the following cloud platforms: Azure, AWS, Kubernetes Preferred qualifications Minimum 5-7 years in the industry. Experience with Cloud native relational databases. Experience on DevOps concepts and way of working. Experience with algorithms and data structures. Proud to share LSEG in the India is Great Place to Work certified (Jun ’25 – Jun ’26). jobDescription: Role Description: The CIAM (Customer Identity and Access Management) platform plays a critical role in enabling secure, scalable, and seamless identity services across enterprise applications, including authentication, authorization, identity lifecycle management, and compliance with global security standards. We are looking for a highly qualified expert Lead Automation Quality Engineer (QE) to drive quality engineering strategy, shape automation and non-functional testing practices, and mentor QE teams across CIAM services, with a strong emphasis on UI, API, and data testing excellence. At LSEG, we are committed to building inclusive teams and fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement. Main Responsibilities / Accountabilities: Define and drive the overall QE strategy, automation roadmap, and quality standards for CIAM platforms Act as a senior individual contributor while mentoring engineers and influencing quality practices across teams Design and architect enterprise-grade test automation frameworks (UI, API, data and service-level testing) Ensure strong coverage across UI, API, and data validation testing (mandatory focus areas) Implement contract testing and stubbing/mocking strategies to ensure robust service validation Ensure end-to-end quality governance across microservices, APIs, data flows, and identity protocols (OAuth, SAML, LDAP) Partner with product, architecture, and engineering leadership to ensure quality-first delivery Define quality metrics, KPIs, and reporting frameworks across CIAM services Drive shift-left and shift-right testing practices across CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes) Validate cloud adoption and migration efforts across AWS/Azure environments Establish observability-driven quality engineering using Datadog and Splunk Champion test reliability, scalability, and maintainability across distributed systems Ensure continuous integration of automated tests into pipelines with high coverage and fast feedback Act as a quality champion, influencing engineering practices and stakeholder decisions Essential Skills & Experience: 10+ years of experience in Quality Engineering / Automation Testing Strong hands-on expertise in Python, Java, or TypeScript Proven experience designing scalable automation frameworks (BDD, TDD, hybrid) Deep expertise in UI & API automation (Selenium, Playwright, Pytest, Allure – mandatory) Strong knowledge of data testing, including SQL, data validation, and data pipeline verification Strong knowledge of REST, SOAP APIs and contract testing Experience with stubbing/mocking and service virtualization (e.g., WireMock, Pact) Experience with CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins), containerization (Docker), orchestration (K8s) Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure) and cloud migration testing Experience with quality/observability tools such as SonarQube, Datadog, Splunk Strong understanding of CIAM domain (OAuth2, OpenID Connect, LDAP) Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments and test management tools (Jira, TestRail) Desired Skills: Exposure to performance testing tools (JMeter, K6) Experience in large-scale identity or security platforms Knowledge of Zero Trust architectures and security testing practices Exposure to accessibility testing standards (WCAG) Strong mentoring, collaboration, and partner communication skills What you’ll get in return High-impact projects: We work on a variety of pioneering AI products and leverage extensive datasets to solve complex, high-value challenges. Competitive benefits: You will enjoy a strong compensation package, comprehensive benefits, and ongoing investment in career growth and skill development. Industry leadership: This is an opportunity to be a founding member of the organization that’s delivering brand-new products that democratize modeling and analytics solutions. Collaborative environment: We provide opportunities for continuous learning and professional development in a work environment of dedicated, highly experienced teams. jobDescription: Senior Associate, FX Client Support – About the Role LSEG is seeking customer-focused, analytical, and technically minded professionals to join our Global FX & Electronic Trading Support team in Mumbai. This is a front-line support role supporting FXAll, a leading electronic trading platform used by banks, asset managers, hedge funds, and corporate clients globally. The role sits at the intersection of technology, financial markets, and client service, requiring individuals who can troubleshoot issues, understand trading workflows, and deliver an exceptional client experience. The ideal candidate will have an interest in Financial Markets, Foreign Exchange (FX), and Electronic Trading, combined with strong problem-solving skills, curiosity, attention to detail, and the ability to work effectively with clients and internal teams. Key Responsibilities Provide frontline support to global FXAll clients, ensuring timely resolution of service requests and incidents. Support clients with enquiries related to: FX trading workflows and platform functionality Trade execution and order management Straight Through Processing (STP) FIX connectivity and electronic trading integrations Platform access, connectivity, and technical issues API and integration-related enquiries Investigate and troubleshoot client-reported issues using available tools, logs, and diagnostic information. Analyze trading activity and workflow issues to determine root causes and drive resolution. Partner with Product, Technology, Network, Operations, and Relationship Management teams to resolve complex client issues. Communicate clearly and professionally with clients, providing regular updates throughout the case lifecycle. Monitor and manage support cases to ensure adherence to SLAs and high standards of customer service. Build strong relationships with clients and internal stakeholders across global teams. Contribute to knowledge-sharing, process improvement initiatives, and operational excellence programs. Develop a strong understanding of FX markets, electronic trading, market structure, and industry best practices. Ensure compliance with company policies, operational controls, and regulatory requirements. Required Skills & Experience Financial Markets & Trading Knowledge Understanding of Capital Markets, Foreign Exchange (FX), or Electronic Trading environments. Knowledge of trade lifecycle concepts and electronic trading workflows. Exposure to FIX Protocol, STP processes, or post-trade workflows is desirable. Interest in financial markets and market technology. Technical & Analytical Skills Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving capabilities. Ability to investigate issues methodically and identify root causes. Good understanding of networking concepts and connectivity troubleshooting. Ability to analyze data, identify patterns, and make informed decisions. Comfortable working with multiple systems and technology platforms. Exposure to APIs, electronic trading platforms, or application support environments is advantageous. Client & Communication Skills Strong customer service orientation with a commitment to delivering exceptional client experiences. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences. Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills. Core Competencies Analytical thinking and attention to detail. Problem-solving and decision-making skills. Ability to perform under pressure in a fast-paced environment. Ownership and accountability. Effective prioritization and time management. Continuous learning mindset. Teamwork and collaboration. Client focus and service excellence. Qualifications 1-3 years of experience in relevant skills, expertise and industry. Experience in Technical Support, Application Support, Operations Support, Production Support, or Client Services within Financial Services, FinTech, or Capital Markets. Experience supporting trading platforms, market infrastructure, or financial technology solutions is preferred. Exposure to CRM tools such as Salesforce is an advantage. Professional qualifications such as CFA, CISI, CAIA, or equivalent financial market certifications are desirable. Preferred Candidate Profile The ideal candidate combines strong client service skills with an interest in financial markets and technology. They are naturally curious, analytical, and capable of troubleshooting trading, workflow, and connectivity issues while working collaboratively with clients and internal teams to deliver effective solutions. title: Audit Director, Operations
jobDescription: Exciting opportunities to join a fast-growing Internal Audit function at the prestigious London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG). LSEG (London Stock Exchange Group) is more than a diversified global financial markets infrastructure and data business. We are dedicated, open-access partners with a dedication to excellence in delivering the services our customers expect from us. With extensive experience, deep knowledge and worldwide presence across financial markets, we enable businesses and economies around the world to fund innovation, manage risk and create jobs. It’s how we’ve contributed to supporting the financial stability and growth of communities and economies globally for more than 300 years. Through a comprehensive suite of trusted financial market infrastructure services – and our open-access model – we provide the flexibility, stability and trust that enable our customers to pursue their ambitions with confidence and clarity. Role Purpose Is accountable for the provision and quality of assurance for one or more LSEG Divisions Provide thorough oversight and support to the audit work conducted by the team. Deliver the portion of the audit plan to time and manage our audit risk through compliance with methodology requirements. Ensure TM+ is progressively updated throughout the audit and has sufficient and appropriate audit evidence. Complete appropriate supervisory reviews. Ensure suitable engagement to remove blockers and quality is maintained. Escalate any issues or problems proactively to Head of Audit to keep overall plan on track. Maintain overall accountability to deliver the audits to time and quality, supporting the SAMs. Actively forward planning to identify hurdles in advance so that there is time to implement solutions. Propose ways forward. No avoidable delays. Own the audit partner relationship, resolve common differences and conflicts. Work with the audit team to ensure the partners are informed of audit progress and findings to maintain our "no surprise" approach. Deliver audit findings and outcomes to partners and resolve common queries or differences. Role Responsibilities Defines the audit vision and strategy for one or more LSEG Divisions, aligning it to the Group-wide audit strategy and the strategic objectives of the Group. Ensures that the Audit Universe and Audit Plan are kept aligned with the Division's key risks, obligations and objectives. Ensures the delivery of a portfolio of audit engagements to high quality, effectively manages audit risk, and that engagements are delivered to agreed timescales and budget. Safeguards that audit reports are clear, concise, risk aligned and acted upon by management. Is accountable for the Audit Opinion for one or more LSEG Divisions and / or Opinions associated with key risk themes. Liaises with other risk management areas to ensure appropriate development, implementation and ongoing compliance with regulatory requirements, risk management policies and procedures. Recruits, develops, motivates and leads a high quality and suitably skilled internal audit team, regardless of whether they are in the direct reporting line, and drive forward positive outcomes in colleague engagement while working with key partners. Minimum Requirements Degree or equivalent, and relevant professional qualification Recognised Internal Auditing (IIA / CIIA) or Accounting Qualification Extensive relevant experience required in leading assurance delivery and supervision SME Technical Knowledge Extensive partner management experience Experience in a fast-paced international organisation would be advantageous Strong communication and collaboration skills Continuous improvement attitude We recognise that to attract the best talent, we need to be flexible, and we are open to discussing work arrangements with you. We take hybrid approach to workplace, this role is Blended (approximately 3 days in the office). title: Associate Business Consultant - Financial Modelling
jobDescription: Financial Modelling & Conversion Team provides support on a wide range of LSEG Excel Add-in products. This involves building/converting financial models for our investment banking, sell side research, asset management, government and corporate clients and handling bespoke requirements of these global clients. In addition, as the Associate’s skills improve, they will develop complex financial models over time. FMC Associates will also ensure that clients obtain maximum value from the LSEG Excel based products by deploying and implementing these tools to develop custom business solutions. Essential Day-to-Day Responsibilities: Work with Investment Bankers, Portfolio Managers, Research Analysts, internal stakeholders, and clients from different financial segments to build/assist in building financial models within Excel. Build customized financial models and convert/rebuild client proprietary templates originally built in competitor products such as FactSet, Bloomberg, and CapIQ using LSEG Add-ins for both buy side and sell side clients. This includes Eikon, Workspace, DataStream(DFO/AFO) excel add-ins. Moreover, the Associate should interpret, analyze the users add in requirements and create workable financial models. Interact with clients on a need basis, recommend solutions to them and provide support on excel add-in and desktop with regards to navigation, functionality, content, data quality and entitlements. Proactively support all assigned accounts in the use of LSEG Excel based products to promote both increased product usage and further establish LSEG products into a client's workflow. Work with Sales Specialists, Client Specialists and Account Managers to ensure that all LSEG Excel based projects contribute to new business generation as well as growth at existing accounts. Provide LSEG Excel Add-ins training to clients via Webex / LiveMeeting or additional one 2 one remote training as appropriate. Work with other teams (Frontline Support, Technical Support, Content, Product management, Account management, Sales Specialists, and Commercial managers) to quickly resolve client issues. Maintain proper account and end user documentation via FMC management systems. Assist in the continual development and evolution of the Financial Modelling and Conversion Team. Communicate regularly with Product Managers about Client feedback on product/content gaps. Regularly communicate the project status to the Manager. undefined Additional Information: Working Hours: Asia, UK, and US Time Zones. Qualification: MBA with concentration preferably in finance or finance-related major. Candidates pursuing any level of their CFA (AIMR) would be highly desirable. Required Skills: At least 2 years of financial services industry experience Preferably in Financial modelling. Experience in portfolio management, equity research or investment banking/related functions is desirable. Strong understanding LSEG products such as Eikon, Workspace, DataStream and excel add ins. Detail-oriented with excellent written and verbal communication skills. Ability to understand global financial language and flex communication style accordingly. MUST have strong analytical skills. Excellent Computer skills - especially Microsoft Excel and VBA (not mandatory though). Familiarity with financial concepts and sound understanding about global financial markets. Excellent problem-solving skills and willingness to handle complex customer problems independently. Ability to work in a challenging environment. High level of engagement with internal groups-GTM & Proposition-to deliver highly customized solutions to end-users. title: Observability Platform Engineer
jobDescription: ROLE SUMMARY: We are hiring Engineers to help build LSEG's internal observability platform - work that directly changes how hundreds of engineering teams across the business understand and operate their services! Our platform brings telemetry, dashboards, alerts, service health, and operational insight into one common experience. It is built on a modular, standards-based stack using OpenTelemetry, Cribl, ClickHouse, Grafana, and Redis, with integration points to Datadog, BigPanda, and other tooling where needed. Cribl is the routing and normalisation backbone of our telemetry pipeline, and engineers in this role will spend significant time designing, building, and evolving Cribl pipelines that move and shape data across the platform. The focus of this role is engineering delivery - designing, building, testing, and documenting features from the product backlog. This is a product engineering role, not an operational or support role. WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING: Platform feature delivery: - Design, build, and maintain Cribl pipelines for telemetry routing, normalisation, enrichment, filtering, and fanout across multiple destinations. - Develop and manage Cribl packs to standardise pipeline logic across teams and signal types. - Deliver features and improvements from the platform product backlog, including design, implementation, testing, and documentation. - Implement and maintain OpenTelemetry collector configurations for diverse signal types, including metrics, logs, traces, and events. - Design and evolve ClickHouse schemas for telemetry storage and query performance. - Build Grafana dashboards and alerting configurations for platform and user team use cases. Integration and infrastructure: - Develop integrations with Datadog, BigPanda, and other downstream systems via APIs and automation. - Write infrastructure-as-code using Terraform for platform components and integrations. - Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and GitOps workflows in collaboration with the DevOps engineer. Standards and collaboration: - Participate in code reviews, uphold engineering standards, and contribute to a healthy engineering culture. - Improve platform documentation, onboarding guides, and self-service processes that reduce dependency on direct support. - Work collaboratively with team members across multiple locations and time zones. WHAT YOU'LL BRING: Essential skills and experience: - Hands-on Cribl experience: building and operating pipelines, routes, and packs in a production environment. - Experience in software or platform engineering, with a track record of delivering production-quality features in a team environment. - Strong software engineering fundamentals: readable code, testing practices, version control, and active code review participation. - Experience developing integrations using REST APIs or event-driven patterns. - Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code using Terraform and with CI/CD pipeline tooling. - Understanding of telemetry concepts including metrics, logs, traces, cardinality, retention, and pipeline design. - Ability to work from a product-style backlog and engage proactively with requirements and acceptance criteria. Desirable skills and experience: - Experience with CriblCloud or Cribl Edge deployment patterns. - Experience building or contributing to internal platforms used by multiple engineering teams. - Experience with ClickHouse SQL or similar columnar or analytical query languages. - Familiarity with cloud environments or hybrid on-premises and cloud deployment patterns. - Experience with GitOps workflows and practices. - Experience in a regulated, financial services, or large enterprise technology environment. WHAT YOU'LL GET IN RETURN: This is a great opportunity to build something that genuinely matters - a platform that improves how engineering teams across a global enterprise understand and operate their systems! title: Senior Dashboard Developer & Data Scientist
jobDescription: ROLE PROFILE The GIM Dashboard Team designs, delivers, and maintains advanced Power BI dashboards that provide deep insights into Group Investment Management’s project and portfolio performance, primarily sourced from Clarity and enterprise data platforms. These dashboards are widely used across LSEG by business managers, portfolio leads, project and programme managers, and senior executives. Reporting to the GIM Dashboards Owner, the Senior Dashboard Developer plays a key role in shaping high‑visibility reporting products that support strategic decision‑making at scale. ROLE SUMMARY The Senior Dashboard Developer is responsible for building intuitive, scalable, and visually consistent Power BI dashboards to support project and programme delivery and executive decision-making. They will participate in briefing sessions, build prototypes and mock-ups, and refine them into production‑ready dashboards supported by strong data modelling and performance optimisation. Success requires technical depth in BI development, strong analytical thinking, stakeholder engagement skills, and the ability to work efficiently in a fast‑moving environment. WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING Design, build, and maintain enterprise‑grade Power BI dashboards used across GIM and broader LSEG leadership. Utilize data science capabilities to inform, improve and optimize data models and dashboard construction. Engage with stakeholders to understand business requirements and produce prototypes (mock-ups, spreadsheets, initial PBIX models). Collaborate with the Data Engineering team to integrate data from the data warehouse, OneLake, or Snowflake. Build robust data models, DAX measures, and efficient transformations using Power Query (M). Develop ETL scripts to ingest and structure data for reporting, including support for modern pipelines (e.g., Fabric Dataflows Gen2, Databricks, PySpark). Optimise Power BI dashboards for high performance, usability, and maintainability. Ensure dashboard UX follows the established style guide and aligns with the GIM reporting framework. Conduct unit testing, peer reviews, support SIT/UAT, and ensure defect resolution. Produce essential documentation: Design Specs, User Guides, Release Notes, and Process Docs. Contribute to improvements in development standards, Agile practices, and Jira processes. Identify data issues or process inefficiencies and contribute to resolution. Support the adoption of Q&A, AI features, and advanced analytics in dashboards where applicable. WHAT YOU'LL BRING Essential Skills & Experience 2+ years hands‑on Power BI development. Advanced SQL (T‑SQL/ANSI SQL) and strong DAX expertise. Proven experience with Power Query (M), data modelling, and performance optimization. Experience with enterprise programme management / PPM tools such as Clarity, Planview, Asana, and JIRA.   Experience implementing Row Level Security (RLS). Strong understanding of data flows from data warehouse to UI. Proficiency with Python or R, with experience in libraries such as scikit-learn, TensorFlow, or similar.  Experience of LLM prompt engineering for systematic feature extraction from unstructured data.   Hands‑on experience with ETL processes and tools. Experience with source control (Git). Strong analytical skills and ability to identify patterns and insights in data. Skilled in requirements analysis, designing specifications, testing, and documentation. Excellent communication skills (written & verbal). Key Behaviors Thrives in rapidly evolving environments with shifting priorities. Collaborative team player—supportive, flexible, proactive, and accountable. Highly organised, self‑disciplined, and detail‑focused. Strong eye for dashboard design, usability, and accessibility. Excellent stakeholder relationship management. Proactive and able to work with minimal supervision. Meets strict deadlines and manages workload effectively. Flexibility to work aligned with UK business hours. Nice to Have (Technical Skills & Experience) Experience with OneLake/Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, Lakehouse, or Dataflows Gen2. Experience with SQL optimisation and modelling. Experience with KQL for Log Analytics or Fabric monitoring. Familiarity with advanced Power BI features such as AI visuals or Q&A. Degree in a numerate discipline (Statistics, Math, Physics, Engineering, Data Science, Computer Science). WHAT YOU’LL GET IN RETURN This role gives you the opportunity to influence some of the most widely used dashboards in LSEG, directly supporting GIM leadership and global business decision‑making. You'll work with Microsoft Fabric, OneLake, and modern BI technologies, expanding your expertise while contributing to high‑impact reporting solutions. We recognise that flexibility attracts the best talent. We are open to discussing work arrangements, and this role follows a Blended (Hybrid) model. Job Details Job Posting Title: Third-Party Risk Management Manager Justification: New Role Job Profile: Manager, Non-financial Risk The Role We are hiring for a Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) Manager to join the LSEG Risk Intelligence (RI) Division. This is a dynamic role requiring an individual to support delivery of the RI division TPRM commitments as well strong governance and stakeholder management. The role reports to the Head of the RI Risk and Controls team. Key Responsibilities Governance Help mature the RI’s TPRM risk lifecycle—covering due diligence, onboarding, ongoing monitoring, issue management, and exit—so that third‑party services are resilient, compliant, secure, and aligned to business objectives. The role drives a risk‑based, data‑driven programme across critical suppliers and outsourced arrangements, partnering with Procurement, Legal, Security, Privacy, and the Business as required. Support the RI TPRM framework, policy, standards, and procedures; ensure alignment with the enterprise risk management framework (ERMF). Maintain risk taxonomy and tiering methodology for vendors (e.g., criticality, data sensitivity, concentration). Help define and track KRIs/KPIs; drive continuous improvement and audit‑readiness. Help ensure the RI TPRM frameworks are in line with regulatory requirements (e.g. DORA, FCA’s Operational Resilience framework, Australia’s CPS 230 Prudential standard). Help ensure the organisation meets all the LSEG TPRM policy divisional requirements. Help develop and manage risk management programs, including scenario testing and stress-testing exercises as required. Risk Assessment Oversee inherent risk scoping and third‑party segmentation. Ensure proportional controls and risk treatment plans aligned to risk appetite. Regulatory Knowledge & Compliance: Help ensure the RI division is aware of and adhering to all required regulations and controls. Support the preparation for audits and regulatory inspections, ensuring that all required documentation and evidence are prepared in advance. Senior Management Communication: Present key TPRM updates to the RI Risk Committee, and to associated Group driven governance forums ensuring they understand potential risks and mitigation strategies. Provide thought leadership and strategic insights on TPRM to senior management. Collaborate cross-functionally with other teams (e.g., IT, legal, compliance) to ensure all aspects of TPRM are being effectively handled. Continuous Improvement: Identify areas for improvement and champion projects to enhance the organisation's overall TPRM posture. Support the development and delivery of training programs to increase awareness of TPRM requirements across the organisation. Skills and Experience Required: TPRM Experience: Strong background in TPRM. Knowledge of regulatory frameworks such as DORA, FCA’s operational resilience agenda, and SOC2 compliance desirable. Experience in defining and implementing TPRM controls, key performance indicators, and key control indicators (KCIs) to measure effectiveness and mitigate risks. Senior-Level Communication & Presentation Skills: Experience presenting complex TPRM data to senior stakeholders in a clear, actionable manner. Ability to influence senior leaders on risk-related decisions and TPRM improvements. Strong report-writing skills to deliver structured and impactful presentations. Scenario Testing & Stress-Testing: Experience in conducting scenario testing and stress-testing exercises, assessing the impact of various risk events on business functions. Key Competencies: Analytical Thinking: Strong ability to analyse TPRM risks and identify solutions that balance resilience with efficiency. Problem-Solving: Ability to think creatively and address complex challenges. Collaboration: Ability to work across teams and divisions and influence colleagues at all levels to improve TPRM risk management processes. Attention to Detail: Strong focus on accuracy and thoroughness when designing controls and assessing risks. Programme Management: Able to plan and execute effectively. Relationship building and stakeholders management skills. Process and detail oriented. Demonstrated ability to take initiative and drive projects to completion. Ability to adapt to change and multi-task in a dynamic environment. Ability to work independently and in a team environment. Able to work effective on their own or as part of a team. Experience Ideal candidate will have a 3+ years of experience in one or more of the following Risk areas - TPRM / Operational Risk Management / Non-Financial Risk Management. Qualifications Ideal candidate will have a minimum of degree level qualification and/or relevant professional qualifications/experience and worked in the financial services sector and have some experience in risk/compliance/audit. Desired Skills and Personal Attributes Analytical thinking Relationship building and stakeholders management skills Process and detail oriented Demonstrated ability to take initiative and drive projects to completion. Ability to adapt to change and multi-task in a dynamic environment. Ability to work independently and in a team environment. Proficiency in the use of Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, Outlook, Power Point and Access) required Able to work effective on their own or as part of a team. title: Senior Engineer - Site Reliability Engineering
jobDescription: Senior Site Reliability Engineer, Risk Intelligence Role summary As a Senior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE), you’ll help build and run reliable, secure, and performant cloud services that our customers depend on. You’ll shape how we define and measure reliability (for example through Service Level Objectives), improve automation in our delivery pipelines, and use infrastructure-as-code to make our platforms easier to operate and scale. We welcome applicants from a range of backgrounds—including SRE, DevOps, Platform Engineering, Systems Engineering, and Software Engineering with strong operations experience. On-call: You’ll take part in a 24x7 team on-call rotation. From time to time, this may include planned out-of-hours maintenance to support a highly available service. We aim to share the load fairly, invest in automation to reduce toil, and continuously improve the on-call experience. Key responsibilities Define, agree, and monitor Service Level Indicators (SLIs) and Service Level Objectives (SLOs) for critical user journeys and cloud components (for example: EKS, DocumentDB, RDS/MySQL, and API Gateway). Design and extend observability using tools such as Datadog and AWS CloudWatch so teams can detect issues early and diagnose them quickly. Lead incident response and drive root-cause analysis and remediation, following change control practices that meet LSEG and client expectations. Partner with Product, Engineering, Customer Support, and leadership to balance reliability, feature delivery, and customer impact. Create and maintain clear operational documentation, runbooks, and procedures as services evolve. Coach and mentor other engineers, helping to embed reliability practices across the team. What you’ll bring Relevant experience in SRE, DevOps, Platform Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related role (or equivalent practical experience). Experience automating infrastructure and delivery workflows—such as Terraform and CI/CD pipelines (for example, GitLab CI/CD). Working knowledge of AWS and common services used to build and operate production systems (for example: Lambda, SQS, API Gateway, DocumentDB, RDS/MySQL, and CloudWatch/CloudWatch Insights). Comfort working across Linux and/or Windows environments. Experience with Kubernetes (including managed services such as Amazon EKS). Ability to script to automate and troubleshoot (for example, Python and/or JavaScript). Experience building actionable monitoring, alerting, and dashboards (for example, Datadog and CloudWatch). Clear communication, curiosity, and a collaborative approach—especially during incidents and post-incident reviews. Good to have Skills: Experience operating Kubernetes clusters beyond day-to-day use (upgrades, capacity planning, networking, security). Software engineering experience in Python and/or JavaScript beyond scripting (testing, packaging, code reviews). Experience improving observability practices at scale (for example: metric design, alert tuning, incident analytics). title: Snr Engineering Manager(Dotnet with Azure)
jobDescription: Why this role We’re building Risk Intelligence products that help customers make trusted decisions in real time. You will take products from 0→1 and 1→n, keeping the customer and product at the center, and own the outcome from discovery and MVP through scaled, reliable operations. You’ll lead by doing with your team, choose the best technology for the job, and create a culture of learning, psychological safety, and excellence. Note: Our current ecosystem includes Azure and .NET among other technologies, but we evaluate and adopt the most appropriate stack for each product/customer outcome and evolve it over time. What you’ll do **Build complete products, 0→1:** Partner with Product/Design to validate problems, shape hypotheses, define MVP scope, and ship v1 quickly. Instrument time‑to‑first‑value (TTFV), learn from usage, and iterate to product‑market fit. **Scale 1→n with reliability:** Grow v1 into resilient, observable, cost‑aware services with clear SLOs, strong incident readiness, and blameless post‑incident learning loops. **Lead by doing (player/coach):** Join critical design sessions, pair when it helps, and review high‑risk PRs while developing engineers via clarity, feedback, and opportunities. **Own live‑site:** Establish pragmatic on‑call practices and a healthy live‑site culture; drive continuous improvement from real production signals. **Engineer for outcomes, not tools:** Guide architecture and platform choices (APIs, domain boundaries, data modeling, eventing, UI) with explicit tradeoffs; evaluate build‑vs‑buy and manage cost/performance/security with measurable impact. **Drive innovation:** Spark lightweight tech spikes and design/experiment workshops; create space for well‑scoped bets that de‑risk the roadmap and unlock step‑changes for customers (learning delivered over slideware). **Build an inclusive, high‑performing team:** Hire well, run effective 1:1s, create psychological safety, and establish growth paths for engineers and tech leads. **Collaborate across the business:** Partner with Risk Intelligence stakeholders to integrate services and meet regulatory/security expectations while simplifying the customer experience. What you’ll bring 8–10+ years in software engineering with 2–4+ years leading teams; shipped and operated customer‑facing services at meaningful scale. Demonstrated 0→1 track record: turning ambiguous problems into MVPs and iterating into durable, scalable solutions with customers. Ability to learn/adapt quickly and pick the right tool—language, framework, or cloud service—based on outcome, operability, and time‑to‑value; willingness to retire tech that no longer serves us. Excellence in communication and stakeholder partnership; comfortable making—and explaining—tradeoffs under time and risk. How we’ll measure success Product outcomes: time‑to‑first‑value (TTFV), adoption/retention of new capabilities, and customer feedback informing roadmap. Software delivery (DORA): improved change lead time and deployment frequency; better failed deployment recovery time and lower change failure rate. Reliability & quality: SLO attainment, incident and defect trends, and strong observability signals across services. Team health: hiring quality/velocity, growth & retention, engagement, and a strong TL/EM bench. Technologies you and the team may use Backends & APIs: .NET/Java/Go/Node (expert in at least 1), REST/gRPC, event‑driven patterns Frontends: Web (React/Next), design systems, accessibility Cloud & Platform: Azure/AWS, container orchestration, CI/CD, IaC, secrets & identity Data & Observability: relational/NoSQL, streaming, metrics/logs/traces, cost telemetry We select and evolve the stack based on customer value, operability, and time‑to‑impact—not allegiance to any single technology. Ways of working Hybrid collaboration with intentional in‑person time for planning/design sprints and post‑incident reviews, while supporting deep work wherever you’re most effective. Manager Operating Principles (what great looks like) Customer & product at the center: We measure success by user outcomes—not just shipped code. Extreme ownership: We build it, ship it, run it—end‑to‑end. Lead by doing: We roll up our sleeves on the moments that matter and raise the bar every day. Outcome‑driven technology: We pick tools for outcomes and change course when the data says so. Learn fast, improve continuously: We use DORA, SLOs, and customer feedback to decide what to fix, build, and stop. Our culture & benefits Our purpose is driving financial stability, empowering economies, and enabling customers to create sustainable growth. We offer formal and informal learning, paid volunteering days, and a strong commitment to inclusion and equal opportunity—with reasonable accommodations throughout hiring and employment. Benefits We are looking for intellectually curious people, passionate about the bigger picture of how technology industry is evolving, ready to ask difficult questions and deal with complicated scenarios! If you are creative and a problem solver, this is the place to be as will be supporting you to fast-forward your career! We enhance each employee’s potential through personal development through a wide range of learning tools both formal and informal. jobDescription: The Manager will sit within the Insights & Analytics team and play a key role in delivering high‑quality research that advises business decisions. briefs Develop, programme, and test questionnaires using Qualtrics Manage survey launches, fieldwork, and progress monitoring Review data quality, carry out cleaning and validation checks Analyse Practical experience using Qualtrics for survey build, logic, analysis, and reporting Ability to turn data into clear, actionable insights and communicate them through well‑structured presentations title: Lead Software Engineer
jobDescription: LSEG Data & Analytics is one of the world’s largest providers of financial markets data and infrastructure. With over 40,000 customers and 400,000 end users across approximately 190 markets, we are an essential partner to the global financial community and redefining the future of data in financial services. We enable customers to draw crucial insights through data, feeds, analytics, AI and workflow solutions. Our engineers design, develop and deliver the products and services that reimagine how our industry works. Driving innovation through digitalisation and AI, we deliver accelerated impact and excellence for customers every day. The Opportunity We are seeking passionate software engineers from mid-level to lead to help us build robust, enterprise-grade solutions that drive real-world impact. Our problems are complex from building AI-powered analytics that are constantly evolving, to challenges that define modern finance, giving engineers the opportunity to stretch their craft and shape solutions that matter. Our software engineers have a strong appetite for innovation, new technologies, and AI, both in how we accelerate engineering and in how we create smarter, more valuable experiences for our customers. We encourage curiosity, experimentation, and continuous learning, giving our teams the opportunity to solve complex challenges at scale. title: Evaluator, Sovereign and Corporate Bonds
jobDescription: Summary: The Evaluator for Sovereign and Corporate Bonds is responsible for providing timely and accurate end-of-day evaluations on fixed income securities for LSEG Pricing Service. LSEG Pricing Service evaluations are used by banks, asset managers, index managers, wealth managers, and auditors for client statements, research, risk analysis, performance metrics, and portfolio valuation. LSEG Pricing Service provides evaluations on over 3MM securities and derivatives daily. Role Responsibilities & Key Accountabilities: • Determine the fair market value for government and corporate bonds in Asian currencies, in particular for India market. • Aggregate and assess appropriate market color to be used in determining fair market value (trades, quotes, contributions), as well as pro-actively drive methodology / automation enhancement to improve coverage and pricing accuracy. • Utilize technical and financial knowledge to improve coverage, accuracy, and timeliness of prices. • Respond to price challenges in a timely manner with explanations of detailed pricing methodology. • Work with bond desk to improve the customer experience. • Document work procedures and methodology enhancements when needed. • Work with various internal teams for content enhancements. • Explain pricing methodologies to customers – both high level and individual security analysis. title: Senior Full Stack Developer
jobDescription: Role Overview: We are looking for a strong, hands-on, versatile, and highly autonomous Senior Full Stack Engineer to design, build, and operate our enterprise People Function Capability Layer. Working within a lean, high-impact team alongside Data Engineers, you will play a dual role: extending backend integration services and enabling data visibility and interaction for business stakeholders. You will be responsible for designing, implementing APIs and building low-code, persona-centric user interfaces (e.g., using Retool) to surface insights and workflows. You will play a key role in ensuring operational excellence, data security, and business continuity in a cloud-native environment. We are seeking someone with strong experience in full-stack development and enterprise application engineering, with a focus on Golang/Python, AWS, JavaScript/TypeScript, Retool, HTML5, and CSS. The candidate will contribute across design, development, deployment, and lifecycle management of applications and services. Key responsibilities: Design, develop, and secure low-latency, scalable RESTful APIs using Golang. Actively contribute to backend service development, supporting event-driven microservices and integration patterns in collaboration with Data Engineers. Develop optimized queries, aggregation logic, and transformation layers to integrate data across relational and NoSQL systems. Design, build, and maintain high-value internal applications tailored to different user personas and workflow needs. Define and enforce technical standards, design patterns, and best practices across development, security, and application architecture. Build and manage CI/CD pipelines to enable efficient and reliable software delivery. Drive observability practices using tools such as Datadog and Grafana to monitor application and infrastructure health. Collaborate with distributed teams and cross-functional stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable, user-centric solutions delivered on time. Design and manage AWS infrastructure to support highly available, low-latency application workloads. Must Have Skills: Strong hands-on experience with Golang/Python for backend development and JavaScript/TypeScript for frontend development, with solid proficiency in HTML5 and CSS for building responsive, user-centric interfaces. Strong experience in API lifecycle management, including schema design, versioning, throttling and payload optimization. Proficiency in Angular for building responsive, scalable front-end applications as part of a full stack development environment. Deep understanding of SOLID principles, dependency injection, and robust error handling patterns. Strong hands-on experience with AWS services – AWS Lambda, SQS, SNS, EC2, S3, RDS, API Gateway, VPC, EKS, ECS, IAM, CloudWatch and cloud-native application design. Strong experience with relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MS SQL) and NoSQL databases (e.g., DynamoDB). Strong hands-on experience with event-driven architectures and message brokers (e.g., Kafka, RabbitMQ). Hands-on experience building distributed systems on AWS and containerization using Docker. Hands-on experience with CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI). Experience with observability platforms such as Datadog, Prometheus, or equivalent. Strong understanding of cloud security best practices including IAM, encryption, vulnerability management, and compliance controls. Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience. 5+ years of full-stack or software engineering experience, with at least 3+ years in full stack development. 3+ years of hands-on experience building full-stack applications, including backend development (Golang/Python, APIs, microservices) and frontend development using JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks, with strong experience integrating UI layers (e.g., Retool or similar low-code platforms) with distributed, event-driven systems on AWS and Kafka. Nice to have: (Review Certifications) AWS certifications such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate, AWS Certified Developer, or equivalent.
