title: Senior Data Engineer
jobDescription: Role Overview: We are looking for a strong, hands-on, highly autonomous Senior Data Engineer to design, build, and operate our enterprise People Function Capability Layer. You will be instrumental in delivering a secure, reliable, scalable, and cost-efficient service layer that integrates multiple systems across the People ecosystem. You will play a critical role in ensuring operational excellence, data integrity, and business continuity in a cloud-native, event-driven environment. We are seeking someone with deep expertise in data engineering, data modelling, and distributed system design, with a focus on Golang, Python, AWS Cloud, and Kafka. The candidate will contribute to the design, development, deployment, and ongoing evolution of our integration and data platforms. Key responsibilities: Build and lead the development of high-performance, event-driven integration pipelines, applying strong debugging and performance optimization skills to ensure resilient data flows. Define and enforce technical standards, design patterns, and engineering best practices across development, security and data governance. Design and enforce canonical data models and schemas to standardize complex organizational data domains across systems. Build and manage CI/CD pipelines to enable reliable, repeatable, and automated software delivery. Drive observability and monitoring using tools such as Datadog and Grafana to ensure system reliability and performance. Collaborate with distributed engineering teams and cross-functional stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable data solutions delivered within agreed timelines. Design, provision, and manage AWS infrastructure to ensure high availability, scalability, and low-latency processing for data workloads. Must Have Skills: Strong hands-on experience in Golang and Python for backend and data engineering use cases. Strong hands-on experience with AWS cloud services – AWS Lambda, SQS, SNS, EC2, S3, RDS, API Gateway, VPC, EKS, ECS, IAM, CloudWatch and cloud-native architecture patterns. Strong experience with relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MS SQL) and NoSQL stores (e.g., DynamoDB). Strong hands-on experience with message brokers and event-driven architectures (e.g., Kafka, RabbitMQ). Hands-on experience designing and implementing RESTful APIs and data services. Hands-on experience with CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI). Experience building highly available, distributed systems on AWS, including containerization using Docker. Hands on experience building highly available distributed systems in AWS and containerization using Docker. Experience with observability platforms such as Datadog, Prometheus, or equivalent. Strong understanding of cloud security best practices including IAM, encryption, secrets management, vulnerability scanning, and compliance controls. Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience. 5+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 3+ years focused on data engineering or distributed data platforms. 3+ years of experience working with Golang, Python, AWS, and Kafka in production environments. title: AI Data Engineer
jobDescription: Role Overview: We are looking for an exceptional AI/GenAI Data Engineer to join our AI Platform team — one of the most technically ambitious initiatives at LSEG. This is not a role to maintain legacy pipelines. You will design and build the systems that make AI possible at HR-market scale. You will operate at the intersection of data engineering, machine learning infrastructure, and large language model applications. Your work will directly impact products used by the largest financial institutions in the world. Key responsibilities: Design and operate high-throughput, low-latency data pipelines Build and maintain the feature stores, vector databases, and data layers that power production ML models and LLM-based applications across LSEG's product suite Architect SQL and NoSQL data systems to serve analytical and operational workloads with strict SLAs, and build real-time event streaming pipelines using Apache Kafka Implement Redis-based caching and pub/sub systems to support sub-millisecond data access for trading and analytics applications Build and deploy machine learning pipelines — from data preprocessing and feature engineering through model training, evaluation, and serving at scale Integrate and fine-tune large language models for different tasks Design and own CI/CD pipelines for data and ML systems, covering automated testing, model validation, and deployment automation Partner with Applied Research, Product Engineering, and Platform teams to translate AI research into reliable, production-grade systems Must Have Skills: LLM & Generative AI: Hands-on experience building LLM-powered applications using APIs from OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar providers. Experience with RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines, embedding models, vector stores, and frameworks such as LangChain or LlamaIndex. Familiarity with prompt engineering, LLM evaluation techniques, and fine-tuning is strongly preferred. MCP (Model Context Protocol): Understanding of MCP primitives for tool invocation, context injection, and secure LLM-to-system interaction. Machine Learning: Solid foundations in supervised and unsupervised machine learning using Scikit-learn, XGBoost, and PyTorch. You should have end-to-end ownership experience — from feature engineering and model training through evaluation, deployment, and production monitoring. Familiarity with MLflow or similar experiment tracking tools and an understanding of model drift detection are expected. Programming — Python & Node.js: Strong Python is essential. You should be comfortable with async programming, writing production-grade APIs with FastAPI, data processing with Pandas and PySpark, and building clean, testable, well-documented code as a default. Node.js with TypeScript experience for event-driven backend services is a plus. SQL — ClickHouse, PostgreSQL & Snowflake: Deep hands-on experience with at least two of ClickHouse, PostgreSQL, and Snowflake. You should be confident with complex query writing and optimisation, indexing strategies, partitioning, window functions, and understanding the trade-offs between OLTP and OLAP workloads. Experience with ClickHouse for high-performance analytical queries on time-series financial data is particularly valued. NoSQL — Elasticsearch & Redis: Production experience with Elasticsearch for full-text search, aggregations, and log analytics — including index lifecycle management, mapping optimisation, and cluster configuration. Redis experience covering caching patterns, pub/sub messaging, Redis Streams, and session management in high-throughput environments. Streaming — Apache Kafka: Hands-on experience with Apache Kafka for building real-time event streaming pipelines. You should be comfortable with producer/consumer patterns, topic partitioning, consumer group management, and Kafka Connect for data integration. Experience with Kafka Streams or processing financial market events (order flow, price ticks, corporate actions) in a low-latency production environment is a strong advantage. CI/CD: Solid understanding of CI/CD principles with hands-on experience using GitHub Actions or Jenkins. You should be comfortable with Docker, Kubernetes, and writing Infrastructure as Code using Terraform or Helm. The expectation is that you treat deployment pipelines as production code — automated testing, rollback strategies, and environment parity are non-negotiable. Cloud — AWS: Primary cloud experience on AWS. You should have working knowledge of core data and compute services — S3, RDS, Redshift, Lambda, ECS/EKS, and SageMaker. Experience with cost optimisation and multi-region architecture design is a plus. Qualifications: 7+ years of hands-on data engineering or ML engineering experience in production environments Strong system design instincts — you consider failure modes, backpressure, and graceful degradation as first-class concerns You default to observability — metrics, tracing, and alerts are built in before systems go live, not retrofitted after incidents You write the runbook. On-call ownership is something you embrace, not avoid Able to communicate technical trade-offs clearly to product managers, data scientists, and senior stakeholders Experience mentoring junior engineers and conducting meaningful technical code reviews Experience with HR data (time-series, tick data, reference data) is a significant advantage Nice to have: (Review Certifications) Cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP Data Engineer) Databricks or Spark-based certification ML / AI certification We're proud to have been recognised as a Great Place to Work® in India ‘25. jobDescription: Role Overview: This role of Technical Lead is within the LSEG RISK Intelligence Technology group. The group develops the technology platforms supporting key products including Connected Risk, World Check, and products in the Risk Managed Services space. Responsible for the analysis, definition, design, construction, testing, installation, modification, and maintenance of properly engineered information systems, containing software as the major component to meet agreed business needs. title: Graph Database Engineer
jobDescription: Graph Database Engineer – Operational Risk and Controls Engineering Company Profile LSEG (London Stock Exchange Group) is a world-leading financial markets infrastructure and data business. We are dedicated, open-access partners with a commitment to excellence in delivering services across Data & Analytics, Capital Markets, and Post Trade. Backed by three hundred years of experience, innovative technologies, and a team of over 23,000 people in 70 countries, our purpose is driving financial stability, empowering economies, and enabling customers to create sustainable growth. Role Profile ·We are seeking an experienced Data Engineer specialising in Graph Databases and Graph Analytics to join our Resilience Engineering team. Working with the Engineering Lead, you will design, develop, and operate graph-based data platforms and solutions that enable critical resilience, operational risk, dependency mapping, and control management use cases across the organisation. ·You will work closely with engineers, architects, product owners, risk specialists, and business customers to model complex relationships between applications, infrastructure, services, controls, processes, and organisational entities. Using technologies such as Neo4j, you will help create actionable insights that improve operational resilience, impact analysis, dependency management, and decision-making Key Responsibilities Graph Data Platform Engineering ·Build and maintain scalable graph data solutions using Neo4j and related technologies. ·Develop graph data models representing applications, services, infrastructure, business processes, controls, risks, and dependencies. ·Implement data ingestion, transformation, and enrichment pipelines from multiple enterprise data sources. ·Optimise graph schemas, queries, and data structures to support high-performance analytics and visualisation. If you have a passion for innovation, a thirst for challenge, and a love for all things fintech, then look no further! We work as a partner to our customers in every major global market. A Scrum Master will be responsible for multiple squads which will deliver outcomes for our customers and sponsors across the business. You will be aligned to the Customer Lifecycle Engineering team and will have the opportunity to support our squads in being best in practice for our product led way of working helping to ensure high quality and efficient deliverables that meet the business needs. If you are interested in working in an engineering team associated with critical, large-scale, dedicated distributed systems that set standards for financial markets, we want you on our team. What you'll be doing: Lead multiple cross functional squads delivering outcomes across platforms such as Salesforce, Docusign, SAP and Siebel, ensuring compliance with our LSEG Change Framework. Deliver work streams of varying size involving multiple internal and external customers. Coach squads in LSEG standard Agile processes, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and guiding teams through Agile maturity to enhance delivery effectiveness and collaboration. Build and maintain delivery artifacts to meet objectives and support stakeholder transparency. Own squad reporting, utilising relevant tools such as Asana, Jira and Confluence, ensuring transparency and clarity on progress and achievements to all customers. Manage risks that arise across delivery workstreams considering size and complexity, prioritising high impact deliverables and activities. jobDescription: Job Profile: Do you want to work with some of the latest technology platforms and address exciting and sophisticated challenges? The role works closely with engineering & other support teams, and customers to deliver outcomes which align to our ambition for LSEG to be one of the world’s great companies! Provide Level 2 support for CrowdStrike, CyberArk EPM, Vormetric, Qualys, Varonis, McAfee (ePO, ENS, ENSSP), and other solutions, including fix technical issues reported by users or detected through monitoring systems. jobDescription: Senior Engineer, Site Reliability Engineering (Cloud Focus: AWS & Azure) Our Team We are evolving our Reliability Engineering team to move beyond support and operations. As a Senior Engineer in Site Reliability, you will be part of a diverse and inclusive organization that has full ownership of the availability, performance, and scalability of one of the most critical shared services at LSEG. We are looking for people with a passion to learn, and who bring a continuous improvement mentality to our team! Main Responsibilities Maintain Service Level Objectives (SLOs) for cloud-hosted systems, continuously measuring and improving availability, latency, and overall system health. Design and implement automation for AWS and Azure environments to scale systems sustainably, prevent service issues, and enable rapid recovery. Partner with development teams to improve reliability, observability, and release velocity using cloud-native tools and guidelines. Participate in on-call rotations, incident response, postmortems, and root cause analysis. Advocate for strong engineering practices for building, deploying, and running scalable, reliable services across AWS and Azure. Enable cloud migration by performing architectural reviews, operational readiness testing, and configuring observability dashboards (e.g., Datadog integrated with AWS CloudWatch and Azure Monitor). title: Manager, Site Reliability Engineering
jobDescription: Manager, Site Reliability Engineering – Shared Services We are seeking an experienced technical and people leader to join our Risk Intelligence Site Reliability Engineering team as Manager – Site Reliability Engineering (SRE). This role is responsible for the reliability and performance of shared services platforms underpinning critical authentication, API, data intelligence, and data warehouse capabilities. You will lead a high-performing SRE team, ensuring these platforms meet high availability, scalability, security, and compliance standards in line with our global Risk Intelligence offerings. The role combines hands-on technical leadership with end-to-end ownership of reliability, incident management, and operational excellence. Working closely with product engineering, data, and risk team members, you will drive a product-led SRE approach embedding resilience, observability, and automation into the platform lifecycle while supporting a unified, scalable operating model across all Risk Intelligence products. Key Responsibilities Technical Leadership & Platform Reliability Own 24×7 reliability and operational excellence for Shared Services platforms (Risk Intelligence Hub, Risk Intelligence Hyper Gateway, Risk Intelligence Lakehouse), ensuring high availability, performance, and security. Define, implement, and continuously improve SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets aligned to business criticality and customer impact. • Lead major incident response as Incident Commander; drive blameless post-incident reviews and ensure learnings translate into systemic improvements. Champion an automation-first approach across incident response, deployment, monitoring, compliance, and operational workflows. Partner with platform and product engineering teams to embed non-functional requirements (reliability, scalability, security, observability) early in the SDLC. Co-own the cloud reliability roadmap, driving standardisation of observability, alerting, ITSM, and incident communication tooling. Ensure disaster recovery (DR), business continuity (BCP), and resilience patterns are consistently implemented, tested, and audit-ready. People Leadership & Site Ownership Lead, mentor, and develop a team of SRE engineers, fostering a culture of accountability, learning, and engineering excellence. Own performance management, career development, succession planning, and capability building for the team. Partner with HR and Talent teams to support workforce planning, strategic hiring, and onboarding in Bangalore. Promote diversity, equity, inclusion, and well-being while ensuring adherence to health and safety standards. Represent the Bangalore site in global SRE and Shared Services forums. Lead and govern vendor and partner engagements. Support site-level operational readiness, including BCP/DR exercises and critical event preparedness. Required Skills & Experience 10+ years of experience in production operations, SRE, or DevOps roles, including 3+ years in a people management role. Proven experience operating cloud-native services on AWS at scale. Hands-on experience with containerization and orchestration technologies (Kubernetes, Docker). Expertise in CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar). Experience with observability and incident management platforms (Datadog, BigPanda, OpenTelemetry, etc.). Strong analytical and problem-solving approach. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Nice to have: experience supporting Snowflake platforms, including reliability, performance tuning, and cost efficiency. Desirable Experience Experience in financial services or investment banking. Familiarity with ITIL, ISO 27001, or related frameworks. Exposure to structured major incident management frameworks. Experience with cost optimization and cloud financial management. Personal Attributes Passionate about engineering excellence, automation, and reliability at scale. Strong people leader with a track record of building and retaining high-performing teams. Strategic problem solver with a bias for action, ownership, and accountability. Calm and decisive under pressure, especially during high-severity incidents. Strong collaborator across global teams. Effective communicator. Committed to continuous learning and improvement. title: Senior Engineer - Site Reliability Engineering
jobDescription: Role Profile: We are strengthening our Site Reliability Engineering capability with a focus on Observability, platform reliability, and operational excellence across the Risk Intelligence division. As a Senior SRE – Observability you will be a deep technical expert and hands-on engineer, responsible for shaping and evolving observability platforms and practices across complex, distributed systems. You will collaborate closely with Architecture, Engineering, Security, and Platform teams to ensure that observability and reliability are embedded into systems from design through production. This is not a people-management. However, you are expected to demonstrate strong ownership, technical leadership, and accountability, including participation in critical incident support when required. This role requires a proactive, delivery-focused engineer with the ability to influence technical direction and drive measurable improvements in reliability and operational efficiency. Key Responsibilities We are looking for a person who is passionate about reliability engineering and who bring a continuous improvement approach to everything they do! Design, build, and scale end-to-end observability platforms across metrics, logs, traces, and events using modern tooling. Define and standardize SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, and observability standards across services. Implement effective monitoring and alerting strategies, improving signal quality and reducing noise and alert fatigue. Drive adoption of modern telemetry standards such as OpenTelemetry and enable distributed tracing, RUM, and synthetic monitoring. Lead incident management improvements, including MTTR reduction, RCA practices, and operational excellence. jobDescription: You'll be joining our FX Trade Advanced Analytics team as a Senior AI Engineer. We're responsible for building and delivering complex analytic applications across our regulated FX trading venues. Advanced Analytics team provides traders with the ability to assess historical trading data with comparisons of liquidity providers and data visualization technology. Our existing analytic capability processes millions of FX trade messages every day on cloud through our big data stack including Python, SnowPark, Oracle and Snowflake. Responsibilities You will be responsible for designing and implementing new analytic and AI‑driven application capabilities within our Big Data analytics ecosystem. This includes building production grade systems that integrate traditional data engineering with modern AI frameworks. You will need strong technical abilities, be able to quickly understand and contribute to existing codebases and express design concepts with a solid understanding of functional programming paradigms and AI system design. As a senior AI engineer, you will be responsible for engineering scalable solutions, maintaining rigorous quality standards, contributing to Agile Scrum processes, and at times interacting directly with product stakeholders. Hands-on experience with Snowflake Cortex, including building or integrating AI/ML pipelines using Cortex functions and services. Integrating LLMs (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.) into production systems. 7+ years of relevant software engineering experience. 3+ years delivering application solutions, ideally using big data technologies. Demonstrated ability to contribute independently while collaborating effectively as part of a team on high profile projects. title: Lead Database SRE
jobDescription: JOB TITLE: Lead Database SRE DEPARTMENT: Infrastructure Platform Engineering REPORTING TO: Senior Manager – Database SRE Role Overview The Lead Database SRE is responsible for the reliability, scalability, security, and automation of enterprise database platforms supporting critical business applications. This role blends deep database engineering expertise with SRE and DevOps principles to ensure highly available, performant, and resilient database services. The role provides both production and development support for database platforms, with strong ownership of operational excellence, automation, incident response, performance engineering, and cloud database operations. The Lead Database SRE acts as a technical authority, customer concern point, and catalyst in modernising database operations through Infrastructure-as-Code and CI/CD practices. This position has a proven focus on Oracle and SQL databases hosted on Microsoft Azure, including the migration of on prem workloads to cloud-native and hybrid architectures. Key Responsibilities Reliability, Operations & Support Ensure high availability, performance, and reliability of database platforms supporting business critical applications. Act as a point of escalation for sophisticated database production incidents and service disruptions. Participate in on-call rotations and shift cover, including non-standard tasks when required. Investigate and resolve incidents using SRE practices such as root cause analysis, error budgets, and post-incident reviews. Monitor database health, capacity, and performance, ensuring proactive issue prevention. Database Engineering & Administration Develop, implement, and maintain database build standards, including security, patching, backup, and HA/DR. Perform database performance tuning, diagnostics, and optimization using tools such as AWR, ASH, ADDM, and execution plan analysis. Define and document backup, restore, upgrade, and disaster recovery procedures. Support database connectivity using ODBC, JDBC, and vendor-specific drivers. Provide database build and advisory support to development and application teams. Review database application code, collaborate on improvements, and maintain artefacts using standard source control tools. SRE, DevOps & Automation Develop and implement automation for database provisioning, configuration, and lifecycle management. Build and maintain Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) using tools such as Terraform and Ansible. Develop and support CI/CD pipelines for database deployments and schema changes. Define and maintain a database observability and alerting strategy, combining automated alerts with targeted manual checks. Promote and implement self-healing, standardisation, and automation-first approaches across database services. Cloud & Migration Lead solution design and implementation of Oracle and SQL databases on Microsoft Azure. Implement and support database migrations from on premise to Azure, ensuring security, resilience, and performance. Work closely with application, cloud, and architecture teams to build scalable and secure database environments. Ensure alignment with enterprise database standards and cloud security controls. Security & Compliance Partner with IT Security teams to maintain and implement database security policies. Apply industry-standard security and compliance controls for database access, encryption, auditing, and identity management. Evaluate applications and database usage to ensure policy alignment. Required Technical Skills & Experience Core SRE / DevOps Skills Demonstrable experience with SRE and DevOps practices for stateful systems. Automation and scripting using Python, Bash/KornShell, PowerShell. Experience with Terraform, Ansible, CI/CD tooling (Jenkins, GitHub/GitLab, Bitbucket, Rundeck). Familiarity with secrets management (HashiCorp Vault). Exposure to containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, Helm). Database Technologies Extensive hands-on experience with: Oracle Databases (11g, 12c, 19c, up to 23ai) RAC, Grid Infrastructure, ASM/ACFS, Data Guard Exadata, RMAN, OEM PL/SQL, APEX Experience with SQL Server (2008–2022) and/or PostgreSQL. Solid understanding of HA/DR architectures and replication technologies. Cloud & Platforms Good experience with Microsoft Azure database platforms. Exposure to AWS (RDS) and hybrid cloud database deployments. Linux administration experience (Red Hat Enterprise Linux, Solaris X86/Sparc). Additional Requirements Experience supporting critical platforms in multi datacentre or multi region environments. Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to operate calmly under pressure. Understanding of ITIL service management frameworks. Familiarity with enterprise monitoring and observability tools. Experience in the finance or banking sector is helpful. Optional / Nice-to-Have Skills Experience with Delphix. Exposure to ServiceNow, Control M, Citrix, or web development platforms. Knowledge of MySQL, MongoDB, Perl scripting. Experience with database migration tools, distributed transactions, and data warehousing platforms. Behavioural & Leadership Skills Strong influencing and partner management skills. Excellent written and verbal communication at technical and business levels. Ability to work independently with minimal supervision. Collaborative demeanor with a proven sense of ownership. Proactive, self motivated, and committed to continuous improvement. Willingness to share knowledge and mentor others. Pragmatic and outcome-focused approach to problem solving. title: Manager – Database SRE
jobDescription: Role Overview The Manager – Database SRE is responsible for leading and scaling the Database Site Reliability Engineering function, ensuring the reliability, security, performance, and availability of enterprise database platforms supporting critical business services. This role combines technical leadership, people management, and platform ownership, driving the adoption of SRE principles, automation, and cloud‑native database practices across both commercial and open‑source database technologies. The Manager Database SRE sets the strategic vision for database reliability and operational excellence, while partnering closely with application, cloud, security, and architecture teams. The role has a main focus on Oracle and SQL databases, with growing responsibility for open‑source and cloud‑native databases including PostgreSQL, MySQL, and NoSQL platforms such as Azure Cosmos DB. Key Responsibilities Leadership & People Management Lead, mentor, and develop a team of Lead and Senior Database SREs, encouraging a high‑performance and innovating culture. Set clear goals, expectations, and career development plans for team members. Promote SRE standard processes, accountability, and continuous improvement across the team. Act as a critical issue contact for sophisticated operational and organisational challenges. Reliability, Operations & Service Ownership Lead the availability, resilience, and reliability SLAs/SLOs for enterprise database platforms. Be responsible for incident response, major incident command, root cause analysis, and post‑incident reviews. Ensure effective on-call coverage, shift rotations, and operational readiness. Drive proactive capacity management, performance optimisation, and risk reduction initiatives. Ensure platform operations align with business priorities and service expectations. Database Platform Strategy & Engineering Define and evolve the database platform strategy, standards, and roadmaps across: Oracle and SQL Server Open-source databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL) NoSQL / cloud databases (Azure Cosmos DB and similar) Ensure standardised approaches for builds, upgrades, patching, backup, recovery, and HA/DR. Supervise complex performance tuning, scalability, and architectural reviews. Guide teams in supporting application and development initiatives with sound database design principles. SRE, DevOps & Automation Enablement Champion automation-first and reliability-by-design approaches for all database services. Supervise development of Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) and configuration management for databases. Ensure consistent use of CI/CD pipelines for database deployments. Define and implement observability, monitoring, and alerting standards for database platforms. Encourage adoption of self-healing, standardisation, and continuous testing practices. Cloud, Migration & Modernisation Lead the design and governance of database services on Microsoft Azure. Supervise and govern database migrations from on‑premise to Azure, including hybrid and phased approaches. Partner with cloud, security, and architecture teams to build secure, scalable, cloud‑native database platforms. Support modernization initiatives across RDBMS and NoSQL platforms. Security, Risk & Compliance Partner with IT Security and Risk teams to define and implement database security policies. Ensure compliance with regulatory, audit, and enterprise security requirements. Be responsible for implementation of encryption, auditing, access controls, and secrets management. Evaluate applications and platform usage for alignment to security and compliance standards. Required Technical Skills & Experience Database Technologies Strong expertise in Oracle Database platforms, including: 11g through 23ai RAC, Grid Infrastructure, ASM/ACFS, Data Guard Exadata, RMAN, OEM PL/SQL, APEX Strong solid understanding of SQL Server. Practical experience managing and supporting: PostgreSQL MySQL NoSQL / cloud databases such as Azure Cosmos DB Deep understanding of HA/DR architectures, replication technologies, and data consistency models. SRE / DevOps & Automation Proven experience applying SRE principles in large, sophisticated environments. Experience with automation and scripting (Python, Bash/KornShell, PowerShell). Hands-on knowledge of Terraform, Ansible, and CI/CD tooling (Jenkins, GitHub/GitLab, Bitbucket, Rundeck). Familiarity with secrets management (HashiCorp Vault). Exposure to container and orchestration ecosystems (Docker, Kubernetes, Helm). Cloud & Platforms Solid experience with Microsoft Azure database services. Exposure to AWS database platforms is beneficial. Proven Linux platform knowledge (Red Hat Enterprise Linux; Solaris experience advantageous). Additional Requirements Experience leading business‑critical platforms across multi‑datacentre or multi‑region environments. Strong collaborator management and decision‑making skills. Ability to prioritise work, handle risk, and communicate trade‑offs clearly to senior interested parties. Experience in finance or banking environments is highly advantageous. Optional / Nice‑to‑Have Skills Experience with Delphix. Knowledge of distributed systems, data warehousing, and transaction management. Experience with database migration and assessment tools. Behavioural & Leadership Skills Strong influencing and leadership presence. Phenomenal communication skills across technical and executive audiences. Strategic demeanor with a pragmatic, delivery-focused approach. Ability to balance hands‑on technical depth with people and platform leadership. Collaborative and inclusive team leader. Dedication to coaching, mentoring, and sharing knowledge. Continuous improvement approach with high ownership. Proud to share LSEG in the India is Great Place to Work certified (Jun ’25 – Jun ’26). title: Application Risk Assessment - Senior Analyst
jobDescription: Application Health (AppHealth) is a new Product Risk Assessment initiative to provide greater visibility and assessment to the Cyber and Technology Risk aspects of LSEG’s in-service application estate. This capability will also be used to deliver business as usual regulatory oversight for Cyber and Technology Risk requirements. Reporting to the Product Owner for Product Risk Assessment, this role will provide the engine of the AppHealth function. Working collaboratively with the LSEG Application Owner population, this role will: Technical: Apply the AppHealth tooling and detection techniques. Support policy enforcement and response plans using insights provided by AppHealth. Understand root causes, challenge assumptions, and assist Application Owners by correct selection of secure design, secure pattern design and security architecture reviews. Customer Focus: I consider customer needs in my work, contribute ideas to improve our product, respond quickly to operational issues that affect or risk affecting customers, and seek feedback with other Cyber and Tech Risk groups to improve how we work. Risk Management: I conduct the Product Risk Assessment reviews which form the core of the role. I drive Product Risk Assessment reviews and evidence assessments. I implement incremental improvements and use the data provided by Product Risk Assessments to contribute to visibility of controls. Leadership: Take accountability for delivering reliable work. I support and coach peers and share knowledge openly. I contribute to team outcomes by collaborating effectively and helping others succeed through trust and shared ownership. Analytical: I apply structured thinking and data to review the responses to Product Risk Assessment responses, solve problems identified as part of the Product Risk Assessment activity, test assumptions, and learn from outcomes. I support team decisions through evidence, insight, and continuous improvement. Work with the AppHealth Product Owner to establish and systemise reporting on AppHealth’s results and outcome to the broad stakeholder groups within LSEG. Adaptability: I continuously learn and adapt to new priorities, try different approaches, and share what works with my team. I make learning my craft a regular habit, not just something I pick up through daily work. Communication: I contribute to team discussions and communicate clearly with peers. I share context, ask questions and help the team align around shared work. The AppHealth initiative is currently in the early stages of operation after successful trials, with a defined future demand and enhancement runway and developing target operating model. This includes both technology and greater alignment with the Group’s corporate planning function; providing insight and feedback on targeted risk reduction activity. This role is within a broader Security Architecture team comprising the Secure Design group. Other teams within the Security Architecture function work with engineering teams; with a separate group delivering a formal control function for Security Architecture. As outlined above, an element of this role is to assist with connecting the outputs and outcomes of Application Health assessments with inputs to other Engineering teams, providing a feedback loop to enhance the Group’s overall security and technology risk posture. title: Lead Database SRE
jobDescription: JOB TITLE: Lead Database SRE DEPARTMENT: Infrastructure Platform Engineering REPORTING TO: Senior Manager – Database SRE Role Overview The Lead Database SRE is responsible for the reliability, scalability, security, and automation of enterprise database platforms supporting critical business applications. This role blends deep database engineering expertise with SRE and DevOps principles to ensure highly available, performant, and resilient database services. The role provides both production and development support for database platforms, with strong ownership of operational excellence, automation, incident response, performance engineering, and cloud database operations. The Lead Database SRE acts as a technical authority, customer concern point, and catalyst in modernising database operations through Infrastructure-as-Code and CI/CD practices. This position has a proven focus on Oracle and SQL databases hosted on Microsoft Azure, including the migration of on prem workloads to cloud-native and hybrid architectures. Key Responsibilities Reliability, Operations & Support Ensure high availability, performance, and reliability of database platforms supporting business critical applications. Act as a point of escalation for sophisticated database production incidents and service disruptions. Participate in on-call rotations and shift cover, including non-standard tasks when required. Investigate and resolve incidents using SRE practices such as root cause analysis, error budgets, and post-incident reviews. Monitor database health, capacity, and performance, ensuring proactive issue prevention. Database Engineering & Administration Develop, implement, and maintain database build standards, including security, patching, backup, and HA/DR. Perform database performance tuning, diagnostics, and optimization using tools such as AWR, ASH, ADDM, and execution plan analysis. Define and document backup, restore, upgrade, and disaster recovery procedures. Support database connectivity using ODBC, JDBC, and vendor-specific drivers. Provide database build and advisory support to development and application teams. Review database application code, collaborate on improvements, and maintain artefacts using standard source control tools. SRE, DevOps & Automation Develop and implement automation for database provisioning, configuration, and lifecycle management. Build and maintain Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) using tools such as Terraform and Ansible. Develop and support CI/CD pipelines for database deployments and schema changes. Define and maintain a database observability and alerting strategy, combining automated alerts with targeted manual checks. Promote and implement self-healing, standardisation, and automation-first approaches across database services. Cloud & Migration Lead solution design and implementation of Oracle and SQL databases on Microsoft Azure. Implement and support database migrations from on premise to Azure, ensuring security, resilience, and performance. Work closely with application, cloud, and architecture teams to build scalable and secure database environments. Ensure alignment with enterprise database standards and cloud security controls. Security & Compliance Partner with IT Security teams to maintain and implement database security policies. Apply industry-standard security and compliance controls for database access, encryption, auditing, and identity management. Evaluate applications and database usage to ensure policy alignment. Required Technical Skills & Experience Core SRE / DevOps Skills Demonstrable experience with SRE and DevOps practices for stateful systems. Automation and scripting using Python, Bash/KornShell, PowerShell. Experience with Terraform, Ansible, CI/CD tooling (Jenkins, GitHub/GitLab, Bitbucket, Rundeck). Familiarity with secrets management (HashiCorp Vault). Exposure to containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, Helm). Database Technologies Extensive hands-on experience with: Oracle Databases (11g, 12c, 19c, up to 23ai) RAC, Grid Infrastructure, ASM/ACFS, Data Guard Exadata, RMAN, OEM PL/SQL, APEX Experience with SQL Server (2008–2022) and/or PostgreSQL. Solid understanding of HA/DR architectures and replication technologies. Cloud & Platforms Good experience with Microsoft Azure database platforms. Exposure to AWS (RDS) and hybrid cloud database deployments. Linux administration experience (Red Hat Enterprise Linux, Solaris X86/Sparc). Additional Requirements Experience supporting critical platforms in multi datacentre or multi region environments. Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to operate calmly under pressure. Understanding of ITIL service management frameworks. Familiarity with enterprise monitoring and observability tools. Experience in the finance or banking sector is helpful. Optional / Nice-to-Have Skills Experience with Delphix. Exposure to ServiceNow, Control M, Citrix, or web development platforms. Knowledge of MySQL, MongoDB, Perl scripting. Experience with database migration tools, distributed transactions, and data warehousing platforms. Behavioural & Leadership Skills Strong influencing and partner management skills. Excellent written and verbal communication at technical and business levels. Ability to work independently with minimal supervision. Collaborative demeanor with a proven sense of ownership. Proactive, self motivated, and committed to continuous improvement. Willingness to share knowledge and mentor others. Pragmatic and outcome-focused approach to problem solving. title: Enterprise Tooling JIRA Support Engineer
jobDescription: Role Profile The Atlassian JIRA Engineer will be part of the Engineering team An Atlassian Engineer (Jira Engineer) configures, administers, and optimizes Atlassian tools—primarily Jira, Jira Service Management (JSM), and Confluence—to streamline team workflows and improve project management. They customize workflows, manage permissions, integrate tools, and maintain system performance, usually requiring 8+ years of experience, scripting skills, and strong analytical. This position requires strong knowledge of Atlassian Tools like JIRA, Confluence, Bitbucket. It also requires knowledge on any one Strategic Portfolio tools like Clarity, Planview and ServiceNow and must have experience in integration of these strategic Enterprise Tooling applications. This position will be accountable for defining solutions on assigned projects for Enterprise Tooling, documenting the solution, and coordinating with Enterprise Architect team in taking the solution through the LSEG governance processes wherever applicable. The Role will have to work with the Enterprise Tooling Product Owner/s to propose solutions to the requirements. This position will need to recommend future Atlassian product Roadmap to align strategically with organization’s Enterprise Tooling Framework. Key Responsibilities Administration & Configuration: Install, configure, and maintain Jira and Confluence, including creating complex workflows, custom fields, screens, and dashboards. Workflow Optimization: Collaborate with stakeholders to map business processes into Atlassian tools and implement workflow automation to reduce manual tasks. System Maintenance: Monitor system performance, perform upgrades, manage user permissions/roles, and ensure the security and reliability of the platform. Integrations & Scripting: Integrate Jira with CI/CD tools (e.g., Bitbucket), chat platforms, and other systems using REST APIs, scripting languages like Groovy, Python, or JavaScript. User Support & Documentation: Provide technical support and documentation for users and create documentation for tools and processes. Strong understanding of the reporting Framework Handle L3 support tickets individually with in agreed SLAs. Work with LSEG Architecture group in defining potential technology solutions and ensuring adherence to architectural principles. Collaborate with business and functional leads to socialise technology projects and obtain cross functional approvals from Legal, Group Risk, Compliance, LCH Ltd/LCH SA, Candidate Profile / Key Skills Workflow Mastery: Expertise in designing and managing complex workflows, including the use of conditions, validators, and post-functions to enforce business rules. JQL (Jira Query Language): Advanced proficiency in JQL for creating complex filters, reports, and dashboards. Scheme Management: Strong understanding of Jira's architecture, including permission schemes, notification schemes, and issue type screen schemes. Jira Service Management (JSM) & ITSM: Knowledge of IT Service Management processes, including setting up SLAs, automation rules, and customer portals ScriptRunner & Groovy: Proficiency in Groovy scripting to extend Jira functionality beyond its native out-of-the-box capabilities. API Integration: Deep knowledge of REST APIs for integrating Atlassian tools with other enterprise systems (e.g., Slack, GitHub, or internal tools). Programming: Foundational skills in Java, Python, or JavaScript (specifically Node.js/React for the Atlassian Forge platform) for building custom plugins or apps Agile Proficiency: Solid understanding of Scrum and Kanban frameworks to ensure Jira configurations effectively support development teams. Infrastructure & OS: Familiarity with Linux/Windows environments and relational databases (SQL). Version Control: Competency with Git/Bitbucket to manage CI/CD pipelines and source code integrations Cloud and SaaS Implementation System Integration AI chatbot, LLMs knowledge is preferred. Stakeholder Management Reporting Frameworks Degree in Computer Science or related technical field or equivalent experience Proven training in software development lifecycle or methodologies Soft Skills: Strong Planning, organisational and stakeholder holder management, with confidence to challenge preconceptions of outcomes and solutions. Good communication, presentation, documentation, and customer engagement skills with proven ability to work effectively with all organisational levels. Global experience – working successfully with teams in multiple locations simultaneously. title: AWS Solution Architect
jobDescription: This is an excellent opportunity to be one of the key people involved in governing digital and marketing platforms and roadmap across the organisation. As part of the Corporate Technology Architecture team, your role is to guide, advise, and recommend how our digital landscape evolves over the coming years and support the delivery teams offering outstanding solutions. Role Overview: We are looking for a seasoned AWS Solution Architect with over 10 years of experience in designing and delivering robust, scalable, and secure cloud solutions. The ideal candidate should have deep technical expertise across a broad range of AWS services, with a strong focus on data integration, serverless computing, enterprise search, and secure web hosting. This role is critical in shaping our cloud architecture strategy and ensuring alignment with business goals. Key Responsibilities: Solution Architecture and implement solutions using AWS Glue, Lambda, API Gateway, and Kafka for both real-time and batch data processing. Design and deploy enterprise search platforms such as Elasticsearch to support scalable and efficient data discovery. Lead the development and hosting of web applications on AWS, ensuring high availability, performance, and cost-efficiency. Define and implement security architectures, including WAF (Web Application Firewall) policies and CDN caching strategies (e.g., CloudFront). Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure cloud solutions meet security, compliance, and operational requirements. Conduct architecture reviews, performance tuning, and cost optimisation exercises. Document architectural decisions, patterns, and best practices. Work with Business Stakeholders, Product Owners, Business Analysts to understand functional and non-functional requirements and interact with other cross-functional teams. Contribute to Customer’s digital marketing strategies based on industry best practices. Help project team to size & estimate project implementation and identify resources and skillset needed for delivery of solution. Required Skills & Experience: 10+ years of experience in cloud architecture, with a strong focus on AWS. Hands-on expertise with AWS Glue, Lambda, API Gateway, Kafka. Experience with Elasticsearch or similar enterprise search technologies. Proficiency in CloudFront, WAF, and other AWS security services. Experience hosting and scaling websites using AWS (e.g., S3, EC2, ECS, Amplify). Strong understanding of cloud security, IAM, and compliance frameworks. Experience with CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure as Code (e.g., CloudFormation, Terraform). Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills. Preferred Qualifications: AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional (preferred but not mandatory). Experience in enterprise-scale environments or regulated industries. Familiarity with observability tools (e.g., CloudWatch, Datadog). Personal skills and capabilities Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate technical information to non-technical partners and to listen to identified concerns and adapt accordingly. Ability to influence across multiple functions (technical and non-technical) Quick Leader: Should understand the new implementation patterns and adapt. A continuous desire and willingness to learn and develop your current knowledge and abilities. Flexible in approach, adapting plans and strategies to help handle risks around ambiguity. title: Tech Lead - Database SRE
jobDescription: About Us: LSEG (London Stock Exchange Group) is more than a diversified global financial markets infrastructure and data business. We are dedicated, open-access partners with a dedication to excellence in delivering the services our customers expect from us. With extensive experience, deep knowledge and worldwide presence across financial markets, we enable businesses and economies around the world to fund innovation, manage risk and create jobs. We employ 25,000 people globally, more than half located in Asia Pacific. As part of the Team, the new resource will support at 360° database layer of several services on different technologies, participate into international projects and have a chance to influence current and future technology choices. There will be occasional weekend work required as Saturdays are used to test and roll forward software and cloud infra releases. Key Responsibilities: Lead, develop, support and maintain critical database applications Team management; demand management, maintaining a shift and on-call rota, regular one to ones, team meetings, annual appraisals Gain an in-depth knowledge of the unit’s processes and ensure team compliance with these processes with solid focus on driving down incidents and problems while delivering changes Advocate and promote Engineering principles, drive quality standards across the database suite Have familiarity with security and operational responsibilities Promoting and driving innovation by actively advocating new tools, processes and technical developments to aid CI/CD Drive automation as much as possible Proactively identify operational and project risks. Provide short term solutions whilst tracking long term resolution. Ensure compliance with risk and security policies Partner with the business and technology team members Act as operational SME for the product while also gaining a solid understanding of the underlying database infrastructure and operations/observability toolset Collaborate with the architecture teams to provide insight into operational impacts. Represent the team at unit meetings such as the CAB, incident review, problem review. Writing and maintaining support documentation, technical specifications and user guides. Able to calmly navigate and work through and resolve engineering and Service issues Assist and guide the team on deployment practices, while implementing improvements to enable further automation of deployments. Good communication skills and the proven track record of working effectively with all organisational levels Continuously adopt a pragmatic, flexible and adaptable approach. Hands on experience of automation Experience with scripting languages; Bash, Groovy, YAML and/or Python Use of CICD tooling such as GIT/Ansible/Jenkins/Nexus/ Preferred Financial services experience Oracle / MSSQL / Postgres /database querying Broad Infrastructure knowledge (Networks, Database, Web, SAN/NAS) Use of JIRA / Kanban to build epics, stories, backlog prioritisation, planning, reporting. title: Anti-Financial Crime Architect
jobDescription: Role profile: We are looking for an experienced Anti-Financial Crime (AFC) Lead Architect to drive the engineering design and product selection, implementation, integration, and continuous enhancement towards global KYC, CDD, and AML compliance. This role combines engineering leadership, product partnership, and deep collaboration with wider Engineering and Operations teams to strengthen LSEG’s financial crime control environment. WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING: Own the target state architecture for AFC, covering AML, Sanctions, KYC, Fraud, and Investigations. Lead the technical design of a new, cloud‑native AFC platform to replace legacy technology. Define architecture patterns, integration approaches, and technology standards for modern AFC systems. Produce high‑quality architecture artefacts including blueprints, capability models, service catalogues, and process maps. Provide architectural oversight for multi‑year AFC transformation programme Partner with engineering, data, compliance, and operations teams to deliver end‑to‑end functional and technical solutions. Participate in design authorities, technical governance forums, and regulatory review processes. Define data architectures for AFC, including domain models, event schemas, lineage, governance, and quality controls. Support implementation of rules engines, anomaly detection, ML models, and risk‑scoring capabilities. WHAT YOU'LL BRING: Essential Skills Proven expertise in delivering architecture and design for modern, cloud‑native AFC platforms and event‑driven architecture. Hands-on design experience with leading KYC/CDD/AML platforms as in-house builds, or vendor platforms like Fenergo, Actimize, Pega, Quantexa, or equivalent. Strong understanding of KYC policy, CDD processes, AML regulations, and customer lifecycle workflows Ability to define and govern target state architectures, reference models, capability maps, and solution blueprints. In depth understanding of key Anti-Financial Crime pillars: Customer Due Diligence / Know your Customer (KYC) Sanctions Screening (customer, payments, entity resolution) Fraud detection and behavioural analytics Case management, investigations, SAR reporting Strong command of data architecture for financial crime, including customer, account, transaction, and risk data models. Demonstrated ability to lead migrations from legacy AFC systems and/or skills in designing data migration strategies Ability to lead architecture workstreams across technology, data, risk, compliance, and operations. Experience supporting design authorities, solutioning guilds, audit and regulatory reviews, and senior stakeholder engagements. Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional leadership. Product-oriented engineering mindset with a focus on quality and outcomes. Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, regulated financial environment. Analytical and structured problem-solving approach. Desirable skills Experience with banking, payments and/or financial services domain Exposure to machine learning for AFC: anomaly detection, risk scoring, feature stores, explainable AI (XAI). WHAT YOU’LL GET IN RETURN: Be part of a global Financial Crime transformation programme. Work with best-in-class vendor platforms and modern engineering stacks. Collaborative, flexible, and globally connected work culture. We recognize that to attract the best talent, we need to be flexible and we are open to discussing work arrangements with you. We take a hybrid approach to workplace, and this role requires blended workstyle. Underpinning our purpose, our values of Integrity, Partnership, Excellence and Change set the standard for everything we do, every day. They guide the way we interact with each other, the partners we work with and our customers. Delivering on our purpose and living up to our values is a responsibility that we all share. To achieve our ambitions through a strong culture, People Leaders need to role model our Values and create the culture for everyone at LSEG to be at their best. title: Senior Enterprise Tools Engineer
jobDescription: The Enterprise Tools Data Engineer is a key member of the Engineering team, responsible for designing and implementing data engineering solutions across the enterprise tooling ecosystem. This role requires deep expertise in Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, AWS, and Kafka to build scalable data platforms, ingestion frameworks, and Lakehouse architectures that enable analytics, reporting, and AI-driven insights. The engineer will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including architecture, analytics, and business stakeholders, to deliver trusted, performant, and compliant datasets. Key responsibilities Design and build end‑to‑end data ingestion pipelines across Snowflake, Fabric, and AWS. Implement batch and streaming ETL/ELT using SQL, Python, and Kafka. Develop scalable Lakehouse architectures (Bronze → Silver → Gold layers). Optimize pipeline performance, cost efficiency, data reliability, and cloud resource utilization. Apply rigorous data quality practices, automated testing, and engineering standards. Partner with analytics engineers and product teams to deliver trusted, well-modelled datasets. Capture requirements and deliver tailored solutions aligned with business needs. Produce detailed technical documentation for all enhancements and deployments. Conduct knowledge‑sharing sessions to uplift team skills and engineering best practices. Work with LSEG Architecture group in defining potential technology solutions and ensuring adherence to architectural principles. Collaborate with business and functional leads to socialise technology projects and obtain cross functional approvals from Legal, Group Risk, Compliance, LCH Ltd/LCH SA, Candidate Profile / Key Skills Technical Skills Mandatory Skills Strong SQL + Python for ETL/ELT on Snowflake & Fabric Pipelines. Experience with API ingestion + streaming (Kafka/Kinesis). Hands‑on with Lakehouse formats (Parquet/Delta/Iceberg). Solid understanding of cloud data architectures (AWS S3, Glue, Lambda). Data modelling + performance tuning in warehouse/lakehouse environments. Understanding Agile Methodologies Optional Skills Snowpark, Fabric Notebooks, dbt‑style transformation frameworks. Event-driven patterns, schema registry, CDC (if applicable). Good to Have (DevOps & Observability) CI/CD for data pipelines, IaaC basics (Terraform). Data quality/observability tools (Great Expectations, Monte Carlo). Working knowledge of Atlassian tools, Project management tools like Clarity or Planview and Service Now Soft Skills: Strong Planning, organizational and stakeholder management, with confidence to challenge preconceptions of outcomes and solutions. Good communication, presentation, documentation, and customer engagement skills with proven ability to work effectively with all organizational levels. Global experience – working successfully with teams in multiple locations simultaneously. title: Vulnerability Management Engineer
jobDescription: LSEG is seeking a deeply technical, hands-on Infrastructure Vulnerability Management Engineer who is passionate about safeguarding complex environments and tackling challenging problems at scale. You will be responsible for identifying, analysing, and driving remediation of infrastructure vulnerabilities across our diverse estate. Combining a hacker’s mindset with an engineer’s discipline, you’ll understand how vulnerabilities are exploited, how to detect and mitigate them, and how to design scalable, sustainable fixes. You will work closely with application, infrastructure, and governance teams to enhance our overall security posture and continuously improve our vulnerability management programme. Who You Are You are a curious and motivated problem-solver who thrives on technical depth and continuous learning. You enjoy delving into vulnerabilities, understanding how they function, and finding the most effective and scalable solutions. You take pride in making a measurable impact on real-world security, not just scanning and reporting. You are collaborative, data-driven, and pragmatic, able to balance security rigour with engineering realities. Above all, you bring intellectual curiosity and drive to learn and adapt in an ever-evolving landscape. Key Responsibilities Core Capabilities & Remediation Perform in-depth technical analysis and validation of infrastructure vulnerabilities, assessing risk, exploitability, and the potential business impact. Develop, document, and deliver technical remediation guidance and solutions to enable application and infrastructure teams to remediate efficiently and consistently. Collaborate with engineering and platform teams to vulnerability mitigation into systemic solutions like infrastructure as code (IaC) and automation pipelines. Analysis, Consultation & Coordination Analyse and review vulnerability findings from tools that identify infrastructure vulnerabilities; verify accuracy, identify and validate false positives, and identify systemic patterns. Act as a trusted consultant to application and infrastructure teams by explaining findings, prioritising fixes, and supporting technical remediation plans. Coordinate remediation activities across multiple teams, ensuring timely closure of high-risk vulnerabilities. Manage and track the remediation backlog, maintaining focus on risk reduction and measurable progress. Governance, Metrics & Continuous Improvement Report on vulnerability metrics and remediation status, collaborating closely with the Vulnerability Management Governance function. Review and approve exceptions or false-positive requests, balancing risk tolerance with operational realities. Perform root cause analysis on recurring or systemic vulnerability issues, driving long-term prevention strategies. Tune and optimise identification tools (e.g., Qualys) to enhance accuracy, signal-to-noise ratio, and detection coverage. Required Skills & Experience Strong technical background in systems and infrastructure (Linux/Windows servers, networking, virtualisation, cloud platforms). Deep understanding of infrastructure vulnerabilities, their root causes, exploitation techniques, and mitigation strategies. Hands-on experience with vulnerability management tools such as Qualys or similar platforms Familiarity with patch management, secure configuration standards (CIS, NIST, ISO 27001), and change management processes. Ability to develop scripts or automation (Python, PowerShell, Bash) to support data analysis and remediation workflows. Strong analytical mindset: able to interpret scan data, prioritise based on risk, and communicate actionable insights to both technical and non-technical audiences. Proven experience collaborating in cross-functional environments with security, DevOps, and infrastructure teams. title: Senior Security Engineer
jobDescription: The Cyber Security Engineering Privileged Access Management team are looking for an independent, pro-active individual who is committed to making an important contribution, to deploy, configure, and maintain PAM platforms to protect privileged accounts and secrets across enterprise infrastructures and cloud services. As a Senior Security Engineer, you will focus on implementing new PAM capabilities, onboarding, operations, automation, and integrations under established architecture and standards. Key Responsibilities Implement PAM capabilities (vaulting, session management/recording, credential rotation, least privilege, EPM/PRA) across on-prem and cloud workloads. Support core PAM features: account discovery/onboarding, credential rotation, policy configuration, and session management. Complete platform maintenance (patching, backups, DR testing), health checks, and performance monitoring; triage incidents and service requests. Integrate PAM with AD/EntraID, IDPs, ticketing/ITSM, CSPM, SIEM/SOAR, DevOps tooling (CI/CD), and secrets management for cloud-native services, assist with workflows and approvals for elevated access. Develop automation scripts (PowerShell/Python) and REST API integrations to scale onboarding and reduce manual effort. Produce and maintain documentation: runbooks, SOPs, configuration baselines, and knowledge articles; chip into compliance evidence. Collaborate with infrastructure, cloud, and security teams to ensure consistent controls and smooth deployments across environments. Technical / job functional knowledge Hands-on experience operating at least one leading PAM platform (e.g., CyberArk, Delinea, BeyondTrust, One Identity). Proficient in MS Azure and AWS/GCP cloud platforms. Proven understanding of Windows/Linux administration, AD/EntraID, networking and database basics, TLS/PKI, and identity integrations. Scripting proficiency (PowerShell/Python) and familiarity with APIs; exposure to Terraform/Cloud automation is a plus. Practical experience in enterprise support: solving, change management, and documenting fixes/runbooks. Additional desired capabilities Exposure to endpoint privilege management, JIT access, secrets management for CI/CD, and container/Kubernetes integrations. Basic familiarity with SIEM tooling and alerting; security certifications or vendor badges are advantageous. title: SOM Enablement Specialist, LDA
jobDescription: This role is responsible for providing strategic order management support on a regional or global basis for Platform Access Commercial deals. The objective of this position is to provide specialist support linking with key PAC partners including the PAC proposition team, regional PAC leads, SAM Account Teams, Legal teams and Project Managers / GBC’s. Their remit is to understand the details of the individual deals, analyzing the impacts, assessing the required activities to deliver the deal, create project plans and communicate these details to all account owning OMS touching the account globally. Responsibilities: Run all elements of the RAAS Checklist to review account details ahead of implementation. Establishes communication plan with all regional BAU OMS. Run Global Bill for RA customers. Review account to assess the validity of the account hierarchy and identify pre-migration cleanse activities in relation to the existing installed base. Validate current contractual situation in regard to the RMA and associated Schedules. Create RA Commercial billing accounts. Run I055/I110 to special price RA inclusive products to zero. Run asset moves for RA inclusive products to new non-billing accounts. Create relevant quotes for new assets provided to the customer as part of the RA deal. Work with GBC / PM to create legacy to strategic product migration plan. Project lead migration plan with BAU OMS. Prepare RA billing according to customer allocations and validate billing globally through proformas, prior to release and subsequently release billing. Scope and Impact: Is responsible for the creation of the RA order form for presentation to the customer. Pro-actively supports the RA project team to identify potential issues with the account hierarchy. Ensures that once the Order Form is signed, all activities required to create a clean invoice for RA are carried out in a timely manner. Ensures all stakeholders involved in the onboarding of a RA deal are aware of the activities required to successfully process the deal. Co-ordinates regional BAU OMS during migration and RA deal implementation. Ensures commercial requirements are accurately reflected on the client’s billing. Raises all open issues and different requirements arising from RA deals to the Program/Project Manager who will then assign a process expert to the resolution of the issue/requirement. Provides Order Management expertise to the account team prior to and during implementation. Required Skills & Competencies: Excellent communication skills. Flexible and adaptable. Strong organizational skills; strong project management, stakeholder management and people influencing skills. Extensive knowledge and understanding of Refinitiv sales order management process, billing systems and business policies. Ability to analyze, evaluate and make logical decisions. Team focused, with the ability to work collaboratively with cross functional partners to achieve Objectives. Ability to work to tight/demanding deadlines/targets in a fast-paced environment. Shown experience working independently, with demonstrated strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills. Attention to detail. title: Lead Engineer
jobDescription: The Cyber Security Engineering Privileged Access Management team are looking for an independent, pro-active, and aspiring individual who is committed to making a meaningful contribution, as a Lead Engineer to lead in the design, implementation, and lifecycle management of enterprise-grade PAM solutions across multi-site and multi-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP). You’ll serve as a technical authority for PAM, shaping standards, delivering sophisticated migrations, and ensure privileged access is secure, auditable, and resilient. Key Responsibilities Design and implement PAM capabilities (vaulting, session management/recording, credential rotation, least privilege, EPM/PRA) across on-prem and cloud workloads. Lead complex integrations with AD/EntraID, IdPs, SIEM/SOAR, CSPM, ITSM, DevOps tooling (CI/CD), and secrets management. Be responsible for the operational model: backup/recovery, DR, platform upgrades, policy hardening, performance tuning, and continuous improvement. Drive onboarding at scale ensuring standardized onboarding patterns and controls. Establish guardrails and RBAC/ABAC models aligned to Zero Trust and regulatory frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST 800-53/63). Define and maintain technical roadmaps, standards, and reference architectures; mentor engineers and review develop/runbooks. Lead security assessments, threat modeling, and control efficacy reviews; partner with risk/compliance and audit functions on evidence and remediation. Solve complex issues end-to-end, including proxy/connector components, high-availability clusters, and multi-region architectures. Technical / job functional knowledge Consistent record implementing and operating PAM at scale in complex enterprises (multi-site, multi-cloud). Hands-on expertise with at least one of the top PAM vendors (e.g., CyberArk, Delinea, BeyondTrust, One Identity), including deployment, integration, and automation. Solid understanding of Windows/Linux administration, AD/EntraID, networking and database fundamentals (TLS/PKI, proxies, firewalls), and identity protocols (SAML/OIDC/OAuth). Automation proficiency (PowerShell, Python, REST APIs) and Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform/CloudFormation) for repeatable deployments. Experience with SIEM (e.g., Splunk, Sentinel, QRadar) and SOAR integrations for session telemetry, alerts, and response. Proven leadership in defining standards, runbooks, and governance; excellent customer engagement and interpersonal skills. Additional desired capabilities Experience with endpoint privilege management (Windows/macOS/Linux), JIT access, and Kubernetes/containers. Exposure to segmentation and network security (micro-segmentation, PAM proxies, bastion hosts). Relevant certifications (e.g., CyberArk Defender/Sentry, Azure/AWS Security, CISSP, CCSP). title: Senior Security Engineer
jobDescription: The Cyber Security Engineering Privileged Access Management team are looking for an independent, pro-active individual who is committed to making an important contribution, to deploy, configure, and maintain PAM platforms to protect privileged accounts and secrets across enterprise infrastructures and cloud services. As a Senior Security Engineer, you’ll focus on onboarding, operations, automation, and integrations under established architecture and standards. This role requires a strong focus on automation and reducing manual onboarding effort. Key Responsibilities Implement and support core PAM features: account discovery/onboarding, credential rotation, policy configuration, and session management. Implement platform maintenance (patching, backups, DR testing), health checks, and performance monitoring; triage incidents and service requests. Integrate PAM with AD/EntraID, IDPs, ticketing/ITSM, CSPM, SIEM/SOAR, DevOps tooling (CI/CD), assist with workflows and approvals for elevated access. Develop automation scripts (PowerShell/Python) and REST API integrations to scale onboarding and reduce manual effort. Produce and maintain documentation: runbooks, SOPs, configuration baselines, and knowledge articles; supply compliance evidence. title: Engineer, Site Reliability Engineering
jobDescription: Role Profile We are looking for a Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) to join our Production SRE Support Team within the Markets and Risk Intelligence division. This role focuses on supporting Snowflake environments and ensuring reliability and operational excellence across production and selected non-production environments. The role involves managing testing, build, and implementation of releases, as well as independent infrastructure and environment support. Working within the wider SRE Support Team, the focus will be on delivering the change programme across all lifecycles—from development, test, UAT, Member Test, to Production environments. A production-focused approach is essential, with resilience, operational readiness, performance, and production support at the forefront of delivery. Flexibility to work across different shifts aligned to UK time is expected, with occasional out-of-hours support including nights, weekends, and holidays. The role involves collaborating with business teams for investigations and providing technical guidance when needed. A good understanding of underlying technologies and the ability to assist developers with fixes or enhancements is important. The ideal candidate should be dedicated and able to manage priorities effectively without rigid oversight. Key Responsibilities Operational Support Monitor and maintain Snowflake databases and related infrastructure for performance, availability, and reliability. Participate in incident management, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis. Maintain and improve documentation, runbooks, and operational procedures. Participate in shift rotations and occasional out-of-hours support. Deployment & Automation Implement releases and changes across development, test, and production environments. Apply standard processes for database administration, including backups, recovery, and security. Automate deployment and maintenance tasks using Infrastructure-as-Code tools (Terraform, CloudFormation). Develop scripts and tools to improve operational efficiency. Monitoring & Performance Configure and maintain monitoring and logging tools (e.g., Datadog) to ensure system health. Analyze system performance and implement improvements for cost efficiency and resilience. Collaboration Work closely with developers and product teams to embed reliability into the software lifecycle. Contribute to knowledge sharing and team documentation. Support global SRE initiatives and cross-regional collaboration. Person Specification Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field or equivalent practical experience. Required Skills and Experience 3–6 years of experience in SRE, DevOps, or related roles. Hands-on experience with Snowflake or other database technologies. Proficiency in SQL and basic query optimization. Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS or Azure) and Infrastructure-as-Code tools (Terraform, CloudFormation). Scripting skills in Python, Bash, or PowerShell. Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices. Experience with monitoring tools (Datadog or similar) and ITSM platforms (ServiceNow preferred). Good communication and problem-solving skills. Personal Attributes Technically curious and detail-oriented. Detail-oriented and proactive in identifying reliability improvements. Strong collaboration skills and ability to work in a fast-paced environment. Passionate about automation, reliability, and continuous improvement. Benefits LSEG offers a competitive compensation package, including equity, annual bonus, and a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental and vision coverage.
